and the V of a curve's data on the plan (KGM 2019 şartname s. 5: “Yatay kurblar proje hızına göre

on a red arrow at the plan's end toward it ("← KAMAN"). At most 80 characters. A parallel axis has its source's.

A PI of an alignment (docs/adr/0901 §2): its persistent id, its place, and the curve on it. The first and the last

schema 192): both curves turn the same way, of different radii, with no clothoid on the side they share.

speed.description:
The design speed at this PI's curve (km/h), when it is not the alignment's (docs/adr/0985; KCAD schema 193):
KGM's 2019 sample sheets write V=110 for one curve and V=50 for a junction's on the same road.

spiralOut.description: The exit clothoid's length; absent or 0: none.

AlignmentStationing.description: An alignment's km: the km at its start and its equations in order.

The project's annotation heights on paper, mm (docs/adr/0205 §1): a

oneOf.description: Ölçülendirme: every kind of dimension.

Tarama.

ApiError.description:
Every error response (TODOS.md ARCH-07, docs/adr/0013): a stable code for
programs, a Turkish message for people that says the cause and the fix,
the request id for support, and what a caller needs to act on it without
reading the message — the field it is about, the project's revision, and
whether and when the same request may be sent again. UI, Python and AI
present the same error in their own way from these fields.

error.description: The stable code (`invalid`, `conflict`, `not_found` …); the name `error` is kept for older clients.

path.description:
The field the error is about, when the server knows it: relative to a
command's input as in `CommandError` (`name`, `tags[2]`,
`features[0].entity`), or a query parameter's name (`q`).

retryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before sending it again, when the server says so (also the `Retry-After` header).

retryable.description:
The same request may be sent again unchanged (the server was briefly
away or asked to wait); false when something must change first. The
server always sends it; a body without it (a proxy's) reads as false.

revision.description:
The project's data revision now, as decimal text (DOM-12), when the
error depends on it: a conflict says which revision the server is at.

modules.description: The project's room modules and their instances (docs/adr/0775, KCAD 142).

openingTypes.description: The project's door and window types (docs/adr/0772, KCAD 137), in the order they were made.

fire regulation's sprinklered escape distances are read (BYKHY Ek-5/B, 48/2). Absent: none.

A part of a multi-part area past its first (docs/adr/0143): its outer

(docs/adr/0224 §1); an area's part has none.

district.description: A neighbourhood's district; only at that level.

oneOf.description: Each item an insert of its own (an item removed by hand is not there).
The array one occurrence (Dizi) of its block; its items not counted apart.

ArrayItem.description: One place of an associative array.

kept.description: Changed by hand (moved, turned, scaled, its block replaced): a layout change leaves it as it is.

uid.description: The insert at this place; none: removed by hand (it stays removed until the array is reset).

ArrayLayout.description:
How the copies are laid out. The originals take the first place and stay
where they are. Coordinates are x east (Y), y north (X), in the
project's units (m), float64.

oneOf.description:
Dizi: `rows` × `cols` places, 2 to 10 000 of them; the copy `j`
columns and `i` rows from the originals moves `j·dx` east and `i·dy`
north. The copies are made row after row, each row column after
column. A direction with more than one place needs a spacing.

Kutupsal dizi: `count` items around `center`, 2 to 1000, the
originals among them, over `fill` degrees (counter-clockwise; minus
clockwise; 360 a full turn). A full turn shares the circle out; a
partial fill puts the last copy on its end. With `rotate` each copy
turns about the centre; without, it keeps its direction and moves as
the middle of the copied objects' box goes round.

Kopyala's Dizi (docs/adr/0291; AutoCAD COPY's Array): `count` places along the displacement (`dx`,
`dy`), 2 to 10 000, the originals at the first: the copy `k` moves `k·(dx, dy)`; with `fit` the last one
moves the whole displacement and the others share it, the copy `k` moving `k·(dx, dy) / (count − 1)`.

Yol boyunca dizi (docs/adr/0140): `count` places, 2 to 10 000, along
the object `path` names by its persistent id (a line, an arc, a
circle or a polyline), the originals at the first, the path's start.
The places are `spacing` metres apart along the path from its start,
or without a spacing spread evenly from its start to its end (round a
closed path, its end being its start). The copy at a place moves by
the path's point there less its start; with `align` it first turns
about the start by the path's direction there less its direction at
the start. The path is read, never changed.

block.description: The source: the block definition every item inserts.

items.description: One per place, in the layout's order (a grid row after row).

layout.description:
How the places are laid out; the first is `p` itself. A path array names its path by its persistent id
and follows it.

p.description:
The first place: where the block's base point goes, its scale (above zero) and turn (radians), as an
insert's.

Attachment.description:
One of an object's attachments: its name, its source (exactly one of
`asset`, `file` and `url`) and an optional note.

asset.description: Embedded: the project library's PNG or JPEG asset its bytes are.

file.description:
Linked: a file's path, relative to the drawing's folder when it is
relative.

name.description: The name shown (the file's name by default).

note.description: A note shown with it (lines allowed).

AttachmentAccept.description: What an attachments item counts and adds.

oneOf.description: Photos, files and addresses.
Only photos (a PNG or JPEG asset, or a link ending in one).
Only what is not a photo: documents and addresses.

AttachmentCreate.description: `POST /v1/tenants/{tenant}/projects/{project}/attachments`: a received upload becomes the project's attachment.

note.description: A word on what it is (“Zemin etüdü, 2. sondaj”), at most 2000 characters.

revision.description: The drawing's revision it goes with (a file project's), if any.

AttachmentView.description: A project's attachment: a report, a sheet, a table, a photo or a source file kept beside the drawing.

viewable.description: Shown in the browser or the phone as it is (a PDF or a picture), not only saved.

AttributeDefinition.description:
One attribute an insert shows as text (docs/adr/0144 §7): the insert's
attribute `tag`, else `value`, written at `p` in the definition's
coordinates, moved with the insert.

align.description: Where `p` is on the text, as a text's (docs/adr/0145).

boxWidth.description: A multiline attribute's box width, metres in the definition's size.

constant.description: Its value is the definition's `value` in every insert; an insert holds none of its own (bit 2).

field.description:
A field (docs/adr/0317 §1): a template whose `{ifade}` parts are filled for each insert (its attributes, its
place, the project's `@` values); the commands that place, sync and update fields write it as the value.

invisible.description: Not drawn: its value is kept, listed and scheduled (DXF 70 bit 1).

movable.description: An insert may move its text (`attributePlaces`); off: locked where the definition puts it (bit 16 set).

multiline.description: Its value may hold line breaks, each a line; wrapped to `boxWidth` when given (an MTEXT attribute).

preset.description: Blok ekle takes its default without asking (bit 8).

prompt.description: What Blok ekle asks for it.

rotation.description: Degrees, counter-clockwise from east, as a text's.

verify.description: Blok ekle asks for it twice, the two the same (bit 4).

widthFactor.description: The letters' width times this, as a text's (docs/adr/0145).

AuthConfig.description: `GET /v1/auth/config`: which ways of signing in this server offers.

publicUrl.description:
Where people open the web app (`KENTOS_PUBLIC_URL`, ending in `/`):
the base of an invitation's link from a desktop, which has no address
of its own (docs/adr/0111). The web uses its own address.

AuthKind.description: The proof a service asks for (docs/adr/0208 §12).

oneOf.description: `name=value` in the address, one or more.
`Name: value` headers, one or more.
HTTP Basic: a user name and a password.
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
An ArcGIS token from `generateToken`, by a user name and a password.
OAuth 2's client credentials at a token address.
Google's API key and session.

oneOf.description: Processed in office software from both receivers' observations.
A real-time vector from one base station.
A real-time vector from a network's correctors.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

baseOffset.description:
Its underside's height over its storey's floor, metres (docs/adr/8041 §3): a lintel's at its opening's head;
absent: it hangs from where its top is (a beam's). Not with an offset.

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

height.description: Its height (kiriş yüksekliği), metres: its top to its underside, the slab within it (TBDY 2018 7.4.1.1 b).

justify.description: How it lies on its axis: its middle (absent), its left face or its right face, as a wall's.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

offset.description:
Its top over where it hangs (the structure's top of the slab over its storey, else its storey's top), metres;
absent: 0.

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

pts.description: Its axis: straight stretches from point to point, at least two points.

role.description: What it is (docs/adr/8041 §3): a beam (absent), a lintel or a bond beam.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

BeamRole.description:
What a beam is (docs/adr/8041 §3): a beam of the frame (kiriş), a lintel over an opening (lento, TBDY 2018 11.5.3) or
a bond beam in a wall (hatıl, TBDY 2018 7.12, 11.3.7).

BlendMode.description:
How a layer's picture meets what is under it (docs/adr/0226 §4: the W3C's
separable blending modes, and addition).

BlockAction.description: An action (docs/adr/0318 §2): the objects (local ids) a parameter's change moves.

oneOf.description:
The objects move by the parameter's change (a linear's along its line, a polar's and a point's by the moved
point).
The objects' points inside the box move by the parameter's change; the rest stay.
The objects scale about the parameter's `from` by its value over its default.

Copies of the objects every `spacing` along a linear parameter's line: one for each further `spacing` its
value holds past its default (the definition shows what the default holds).
The objects turn about an angle parameter's centre by its change.
The objects mirror about a flip parameter's line while it is on.

BlockCard.description:
A block's library card (docs/adr/0317 §4): what the Bloklar panel's cards and search show beside its name, its
description, its size and its attributes.

category.description: A path of categories by `/` (`Mimari/Kapılar`); absent: none.

publication.description: Stable library identity, independent of the drawing's local edit counter.

tags.description: Words it is found by, each once, Turkish case folded.

version.description:
How many times its definition has changed since it was made: 1 when made; each change of its objects, base,
attributes or unit adds one.

BlockDefinition.description:
A block definition (docs/adr/0144): objects drawn once, placed many
times. Its objects' ids are local to it, once each and kept by every edit
of it, so a reference to a piece follows it (docs/adr/0315 §1). An object
on the block's layer (`""`, the DXF's layer 0) is drawn on its insert's
layer; one on a layer of its own shows only while that layer does
(docs/adr/0315 §2). A part of its look it has is its own, a `byLayer` part
its layer's (its insert's layer on the block's layer), any other part its
insert's (BYBLOCK).

attributes.description: The texts an insert shows from its attributes (ATTDEF).

base.description: The point placed at an insert's `p`, in the definition's coordinates.

card.description: Its library card (docs/adr/0317 §4): category, tags and version.

dynamic.description: Its parameters and actions (docs/adr/0318): one definition at many sizes and looks.

name.description: Unique in the drawing, Turkish case folded.

units.description:
The unit it was drawn in (docs/adr/0315 §4): a unit, its geometry being metres as the drawing's (an insert
keeps its size anywhere); `unitless`, its numbers being drawing units (an insert is scaled by the drawing's
unit). Absent: a real-size block of an unknown unit.

xref.description: An external reference's source (docs/adr/0348 §1): its objects are that drawing's as last loaded.

BlockList.description:
`GET …/blocks`: the project's block definitions, as `ProjectInfo.blocks`
(a client asks after an event names changed blocks).

BlockParameter.description: A parameter (docs/adr/0318 §1). Its points are the definition's coordinates.

oneOf.description: A length along `from`→`to`: its default the distance between them; a change moves `to` along the line.
`to` moved anywhere: its value a point, its rule on the distance from `from`.
An angle about `center`, radians counter-clockwise from east; its default `base`.
A point: its default `at`.
A mirror about the line `a`→`b`, off by default.
The objects shown: its first state by default.
Rows of values set together, chosen by label; it has no value of its own to keep.

BlockParameterGroup.description: A property-panel heading and the exact parameter names it contains, in display order.

BlockPublication.description:
The publisher-assigned identity of a 2D component type and its release.
This is metadata, not a signature or permission to update a drawing.

typeId.description: Stable across release and display-name changes, independent of the drawing's block id.

BlockRecord.description: One stored block definition (docs/adr/0144 §5) and its version.

BlockUnits.description: The unit a block was drawn in (docs/adr/0315 §4).

oneOf.description: Its numbers are the drawing's units: a 1 is a millimetre in a millimetre drawing, a metre in a metre one.

BreakLine.description: Which of a dimension's lines a break is on.

oneOf.description: The dimension line, from its first end (0) to its second (1).
The first extension line, from the measured point (0) to its far end (1).
The second.

landTotal.description:
Arsa payı paydası (docs/adr/8031; `.kcad` schema 223): the whole the land shares are written over; none: the
parcel's area in whole m² when the project has a zoning, else the units' weighted areas in whole m² summed.

shareRule.description: How the common areas are shared out to the independent units (docs/adr/0784 §2); none: they are not.

CadElement.description: A part of an object a constraint names.

oneOf.description:
A point: a line's or an arc's start or end, a circle's or an arc's centre, a point object's node, a path's
vertex. Not a place along a curve nor an edge's middle.

A straight segment: a line (all zero) or a path's straight edge from vertex `index` to the next (part 0 the
object's own path, ring 0 its outer ring).
The circle of a path's circular edge. Its endpoints remain the path's Vertex points; the bulge can vary.
A circle, or an arc's circle.

A line of a wall's straight edge `edge` (docs/adr/0770 §4): a face, its axis or a face of its core, left and
right by the path's direction. Only the architectural rules take it (distance, parallel, symmetric, fix).
An opening's start or end jamb, the middle of its jamb line (docs/adr/0770 §4, 0694).

A straight grid's line (docs/adr/8049 §2): it moves square to itself as a wall's edge does, the walls and
openings bonded to it following. Only the architectural rules take it (distance, parallel, symmetric, fix).

A side of a column's box (docs/adr/8049 §3): `side` 0–3 from its first corner counter-clockwise, as
`cad.columns.distances` numbers them; a line as a wall's is, the column moving square to it (a column tied
to grids with them). Only the architectural rules take it (distance, parallel, symmetric, fix).

A boundary edge (docs/adr/2580): an area's or a single path's straight edge from vertex `index` to the next
(part 0, ring 0 the outer ring or the path, 1… the holes) that moves only parallel to itself, its neighbours
lengthening or shortening to meet it (Paralel kaydır's rule, docs/adr/0191). Only the map bond takes it: the
distance from a straight segment (`Segment`, or another boundary) to it.

CadParameter.description: A named parameter: a dimensional constraint's own, or the user's (AutoCAD's user parameter).

expression.description:
Its value as written ([`crate::constraint_expr`]); empty for a reference constraint's parameter, whose value
is measured.

min.description: The least and the most its value may be, in its own unit.

CadWork.description:
What a CAD project is drawn for (docs/adr/0801, 0802; the Yeni proje
wizard's works, docs/adr/0626 §1): a building or a map and zoning plan, the
two CAD programs KentOS has (the owner: “bizde iki tür cad var mimari ve
harita”); and a road (plan/road.md), KentOS Yol's. It decides the KentOS
program the project belongs to (KentOS Mimari, KentOS Harita, KentOS Yol)
and the ribbon's tabs and panels; it never changes
what the data means, and every command still runs. Only a CAD project has one; one written before works has none and the
desktop asks it once. Like its type, a project keeps the work it has.

oneOf.description: Mimari proje: buildings, floor plans, sections and elevations.
Harita / imar planı: site plans, zoning, surveys and infrastructure.
Yol projesi: terrain, alignments, profiles, sections and earthworks (plan/road.md; `.kcad` schema 158).
Level, then upright.

CaseworkBreak.description: Why a run did not follow its walls: one is gone, or the path they give lays no run.

CaseworkCorner.description:
How a run turns a corner (docs/adr/0727 §1): the leg before keeps the corner (a blind corner, a 5 cm filler after
it), or both legs stop a cabinet's depth from it (an open corner, its square a filler).

CaseworkDoor.description: The side a single door hinges on, as one faces the cabinet.

CaseworkEnd.description: An end of a run's path.

CaseworkFace.description: A wall's face, relative to its path's direction.

CaseworkMember.description:
An object of a run: its persistent id, its part and, for modules, uppers, fillers and corners, its number (a
module's, a leg's from 0, a corner's from 1).

CaseworkModuleSetting.description: A module's own values (docs/adr/0727 §2): its width instead of the run's default, its door's hand.

hand.description: Its door's hinge; a double door (over 0.60 m) and an appliance have none.

module.description: The module, counted from `from` along the path (1 the first).

width.description: Its width, one of the cabinet block's widths.

CaseworkPart.description: What an object of a run is in it.

oneOf.description: A module's floor unit: a base cabinet, the dishwasher, the oven.
The sink on its module.
The cooktop on its module.
A wall cabinet over a module.
A leg's filler.
A corner's filler.
The countertop.

CaseworkRecord.description:
A kitchen run as the drawing keeps it (docs/adr/0727 §5): its recipe (`cad.casework.run`'s input without an
expected revision), each leg's wall face (none: it stands free), its objects and why it no longer follows.

CaseworkRun.description:
Input of `cad.casework.run` v1 (“Mutfak dizisi”, docs/adr/0706, 0727): base cabinets along the path where their
backs stand (a wall's face): `from`, the corners `through` (none: straight, one: an L, two: a U), `to`, on its
`side`; modules of `module` width numbered from `from`, the sink's module (`sink`) 0.90 m, the cooktop's
(`cooktop`) at least 0.60 m, the dishwasher's (`dishwasher`) and the oven under the cooktop (`oven`) 0.60 m, a
module's own width and door (`perModule`); the fridge at an end (`fridge`); what is left on a leg a filler. The
countertop covers the path but the fridge, `depth` deep, mitred at the corners, cut for the sink and the cooktop;
`upper` adds wall cabinets over the modules. KentOS's library blocks (Alt dolap, Evye, Ocak, Bulaşık makinesi,
Fırın, Buzdolabı, Üst dolap) are brought in the same step when the drawing has none of their names. The run is
kept as the drawing's record (`casework`): its legs tied to the wall faces they stand on, it follows them.

Refusals, in this order: `not_finite`, `invalid_casework` (too many corners, a leg with no length, a depth out of
its range, a corner not square or turning away from the cabinets, a module's own values given twice, a block
without its width parameter, a width not one of the cabinet's, a leg too short for a module, a sink, cooktop,
dishwasher or module's values outside the run, two of them in one module, an oven without a cooktop, an
appliance's width, a door given an appliance or a double door, a sink or cooktop that does not fit its module or
the countertop, the wall cabinet's widths), `invalid_line_weight`, `invalid_revision`, `revision_conflict`,
`layer_not_found`, `not_a_layer`, `layer_locked`; on the desktop also `slots_exhausted`. Warnings: `layer_hidden`,
`casework_filler`, `casework_blind_corner`, `casework_clash`.

corner.description: How it turns its corners; absent: blind.

depth.description: The countertop's depth, from 0.30 to 1.20 m; absent: 0.60.

fridge.description: The fridge at an end of the path; absent: none.

from.description: Where the run starts, on the line its backs stand on.

layerId.description: The layer the run goes on, a layer's id.

module.description: A base cabinet's width (one of the cabinet block's widths: 0.30 to 1.20 m by 0.15); absent: 0.60.

side.description: The side it stands on; absent: left.

sink.description: The sink's module, counted from `from` (1 the first); absent: none.

through.description: Its corners in order: one an L, two a U; absent: a straight run.

CaseworkSide.description: Which side of its path a run stands on, as one walks from `from` (the room's side).

CaseworkTie.description: The wall face edge a leg stands on (docs/adr/0727 §5).

edge.description: The face's edge, from 0 along the wall's path.

Cell.description: A cell of a combination: a code of its field's list, any value (empty too), or empty.

CellField.description: A cell bound to a source (docs/adr/0327 §3): its words are the value last written, `####` when broken.

CellFormula.description: A cell's formula (docs/adr/0327 §2): its words begin with `=`; the cell's words are its result.

CellRange.description: A merged range: `rows` × `cols` cells from row `row`, column `col`.

CellStyle.description:
A style over a range of cells (docs/adr/0327 §1); what it leaves absent the cells take from the styles before it,
then from the table.

color.description: Its words' colour, `#rrggbb`.

decimals.description: The decimals a formula's or a field's number is written with.

oneOf.description: When the record is saved: not while the value is typed.

When the record goes forward in the form's workflow (a step); a form without a workflow asks it
when the record is saved.
Once its field was left (focus moved on, a list's value chosen), and on saving (docs/adr/0760 §1).

objects.description: How many objects the file holds (decimal text), when it is known.

revision.description:
The data revision a snapshot shows, or the file revision a file
project's checkpoint names (decimal text).

size.description: The file's size in bytes (decimal text).

oneOf.description: A database project's snapshot, kept in the object store.
A file project's revision, named.

CircleEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

ClipFrame.description: How a clipping boundary's frame shows.

oneOf.description: Not drawn.
Drawn on the screen over the drawing, never plotted.
Drawn with the content, in the insert's look, and plotted.

CloudHeights.description:
What the ground taken from clouds rests on when the call says the clouds' heights (docs/adr/1032): `from`, the
clouds' as said; `to`, the project's the points were written in. Where the two differ the heights went from one to
the other by the geoid models (H = h − N), as `cad.crs.transform` turns them; where they are one, unchanged.

oneOf.description: The file's colours.
ASPRS's classes, each its colour.
Heights through a ramp.
Intensity in grey.
Single, first, intermediate and last returns in four colours.
The object's colour.

CloudReturns.description:
Which of a pulse's returns a cloud's points are taken from (docs/adr/0928): all, the first, the last (nearest the
ground), or a pulse's only return.

asset.description:
The project library's asset its bytes are (embedded); exactly one of
`asset`, `file` and `url` is given.

bounds.description: `[x₁, y₁, z₁, x₂, y₂, z₂]`, as its header says.

count.description: Its points, as its header says.

file.description: The file (linked): absolute, or relative to the drawing's folder.

pose.description:
Schema 251 (docs/adr/5100): the file's place in the drawing without writing it again — a rigid map of 16
numbers, row by row (rotation in the upper left 3 × 3, translation in the fourth column, the bottom row 0 0 0
1), taking the file's points to the drawing's; absent: where the file says. Its points are drawn, queried and
measured there; only Dönüşüm uygula writes them so.

url.description: An HTTP or HTTPS address read by ranges.

ColumnAnchor.description:
Which of a column's nine points its `at` is (docs/adr/0725 §2), Archicad's reference axis of the column core: on its
box before its turn, left and right across its width, bottom and top along its depth.

ColumnBreak.description: Why a column is not where its grids say.

oneOf.description: One of its grids is gone, or they no longer cross.

anchor.description: Which point of its box `at` is (docs/adr/0725 §2); absent: its centre.

at.description:
Its reference point (docs/adr/0725 §2): its centre, or the point of its box its `anchor` names; where its grids
cross when it stands on them.

§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

§3.7), one a class at most.

legs.description:
An L's legs (docs/adr/0725 §3), metres: the thickness of the one along its width (measured along its depth),
then of the one along its depth (measured across its width); only an L's, which needs them.

material.description:
Its material (docs/adr/8041 §2); absent: Betonarme. Where it meets a wall's layer of the same material the two

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

place.description: Its place by its grids' labels (“B-3”), which the document writes.

rotation.description: Its turn, radians counter-clockwise, about its reference point.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

column.description: Its column whose value the field holds (`id`).

label.description: Its column whose value names a row in the list (`ad`); none: the codes themselves.

table.description: The table as its source names it (`kbs.iller`; a GeoPackage's table).

oneOf.description:
An L (docs/adr/0725 §3): two legs from its box's lower left corner, one along its width and one along its
depth, as thick as its `legs` say.

Combination.description: One combination: a cell for each field of its group, in the group's order.

subtype.description: The subtype whose records it is for (docs/adr/0422); none: every record's.

expectedVersions.description: Row version each touched object had when the edit started; bigint as decimal text (§24.1).

idempotencyKey.description: The same key returns the same result on retry (no duplicate commit).

version.description: Version of the command's input schema; unknown versions are refused.

lineWeight.description: Paper mm, 0 to 100.

ComponentHatch.description:
A component's hatch: a pattern of the library or the project by its name (`SOLID` a solid fill), as large on paper
as at 1:1 times `scale` at every drawing scale, turned `angle` degrees along the wall's path, in its own colour.

scale.description: Times the pattern's paper size, above 0.

oneOf.description: Someone saved a newer version.
Someone deleted it.
A created id is already taken.
The project's metadata changed.

reference.description:
A dimensional constraint that only measures (AutoCAD's reference constraint): it never moves anything and its
parameter, read-only, takes the measured value.

ConstraintRule.description:
What a constraint holds. The geometric kinds come first in the order AutoCAD's toolbar has them; the
dimensional ones name the parameter that gives (or, for a reference constraint, takes) their value.

oneOf.description: A point on a point, or on a segment's line or a circle.
A segment level, or two points level.
A segment upright, or two points one above the other.

A segment's line or a circle touching a circle. With a segment, `left`: the circle's centre is on the left of
the segment's direction; with two circles, `inside`: one inside the other. Set when the constraint is made,
from the drawing: the solution keeps that side.
Two segments on one line.
Two segments of one length, or two circles of one radius.
Two points mirror each other over a segment's line.
A point, a segment's ends or a circle's centre and radius stay where they are.

The distance from a point to a point, or (aligned only) to a segment's line; with a segment, `left`: the
point is on the left of the segment's direction (set when made). Horizontal and vertical distances are
signed: `b` minus `a`.

The angle from segment `a`'s direction to `b`'s, counter-clockwise; `reverseA`, `reverseB`: a segment taken
from its end to its start (chosen when made, so the angle measured is the one the user picked).

what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

Convention.description:
Which way a Helmert transformation's rotations turn: EPSG's position
vector convention (9606) or its coordinate frame convention (9607).

CorrelationBlock.description: The correlations between two baselines of a session, X, Y, Z by X, Y, Z, row by row.

CorridorDef.description:
A corridor (docs/adr/0905): on an alignment of its own PIs (its revision held), its profile's elevations, the
surface its slopes meet, an optional superelevation schedule, the swath searched on each side (m), how often it
is sampled (the tangent and curve intervals, an optional chord tolerance; the profile's points, the critical
stations and the stations written) and its regions in order.

critical.description: The superelevation schedule's critical stations are sampled too.

profilePoints.description: The profile's PVIs, its vertical curves' ends and its high and low points are sampled too.

refine.description: The sections between stations measured and the stations refined (docs/adr/0939 §2; schema 170).

stations.description: Stations the user wrote (the alignment's own, m).

verticalSag.description: The chord height the profile's vertical curves are divided by (m; docs/adr/0939 §1; schema 170).

CorridorRefineDef.description:
How a corridor's sampling is checked (docs/adr/0939 §2): the plan distance and the height a section between two
stations may stray from their straight join (m; absent: not checked), and the least step an interval is halved to
(m). A section whose kind changes (cut to fill, a slope that meets nothing, none) halves it in any case.

CorridorRegionDef.description:
A corridor's region (docs/adr/0905 §1): the alignment's stations it spans (m) and its template; and an optional
slope transition (docs/adr/0960, KCAD schema 178): over its first `transition` m the sides' cut and fill slopes go
linearly from the region before's template's to its own. The region before ends where it starts.

CountScope.description: What a recipe counts (docs/adr/1030 §3): each choice open, none implied.

hidden.description:
Görünmeyen parçalar: a dynamic block's pieces its visibility state hides and the objects on a hidden or frozen
layer are counted too. Off: left out (the report says how many).

nested.description:
İç içe bloklar: a block's objects are looked into, its nested inserts counted (each by its path), its pieces'
lengths and areas measured as placed. Off: the drawing's own objects alone.

xrefs.description:
Dış referanslar: an external reference's content is looked into as a nested block's (its objects by their
source ids). Off: an external reference is one insert. A reference to a drawing the recipe reads itself is
never looked into: that drawing is counted once, as its own.

CrossingSide.description: Where a crossed structure is against the road (docs/adr/0946).

oneOf.description: Over the road (a bridge, an overpass, a line): its elevation is its underside, the road passes under it.
Under the road (a culvert, a pipe): its elevation is its top, the road passes over it.

CrsBase.description:
A local system's base: a projected system of the registry by its EPSG
code (`srid`), or a transverse Mercator the project defines
(`definition`); exactly one.

CrsDefinition.description:
A coordinate system the project defines (docs/adr/0168 §1): its name
and what it is.

CrsPlane.description:
A local system's coordinates to its base's: base x = a·x + b·y + c,
base y = d·x + e·y + f; a similarity turns counter-clockwise (degrees),
scales, then shifts.

CrsSystem.description: The kind of system a definition is.

CulvertDef.description:
A culvert across a corridor (docs/adr/0909 §2): its corridor and that corridor's revision it was made from, its
station and skew (degrees from the cross, positive ahead on the right), its barrel, its flow line under the axis and
its fall (a grade, 0.02 is 2 %; docs/adr/0977) toward `flow`, the length added beyond each toe, the least cover asked, its material and Manning
roughness (typed, kept).

CulvertFlow.description: The side a culvert's water runs to.

CulvertShapeDef.description: A culvert's barrel cross (docs/adr/0909 §2): pipes side by side (`spacing` their clear gap) or a box of cells.

CustomDatum.description:
A datum the project defines: its ellipsoid and, when it has one, its
seven parameters to WGS 84 (without them it stands alone).

DatasetDim.description:
One of a dataset's slice dimensions (docs/adr/0243 §6): its name, the
index shown, its values (coordinates; moments in milliseconds since 1970
when `time`) and units.

time.description: The values are a CF time axis's moments.

DatasetInfo.description: A layer's description as a dataset; every part may be left out, an empty one is not written.

accuracy.description: Its positional accuracy (one standard deviation), in metres.

completeness.description: How complete it is, in words (“ilçenin bütün parselleri”).

constraints.description: What its use is bound by (Kullanım kısıtı).

resolution.description: Its resolution: a raster's cell or the smallest detail it keeps, in metres.

scale.description: The scale it was made for: the denominator (1000 for 1:1000).

statement.description: How it was made (Üretim açıklaması): survey, digitising, import.

title.description: Its title; the layer's name stands for it when absent.

updated.description: The day its data was last brought up to date (`YYYY-AA-GG`).

DatasetParty.description: Who answers for the data (ISO 19115's responsible party, OGC API Records' contact).

name.description: A person's or a unit's name.

DatumTransform.description:
The project's choice for a pair of the registry's datums instead of
EPSG's way (docs/adr/0168 §3); the pair's other way is its reverse. It
shifts by seven parameters (`helmert`) or an NTv2 grid (`grid`); exactly
one.

name.description: What the values rest on: “ED50 → TUREF: Bölge 7”.

DeliveryView.description: One notification's way to the account by e-mail or SMS.

state.description: `pending` (on its way or to be tried again), `sent` or `failed` (given up).

DerivationInput.description:
A layer a derivation read: the layer then (its id and name), its content digest when read
(`sources::layer_digest`, docs/adr/0511), and for a bound layer its source.

source.description: The file or database address (without a password) a bound layer's table is in, and its table.

DesignOption.description: One alternative of a set: its id, its name and its objects by their persistent ids.

DeviceTerminal.description: A terminal: its id (lower-case letters, digits and hyphens) and its name (what the tools say).

DimensionArrow.description:
A dimension's arrowheads other than the oblique tick, which is no value but
the field's absence (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: A filled triangle, its tip on the dimension line's end (Dolu ok).
The triangle's two sides (Açık ok).
A filled circle about the end (Nokta).
Nothing at the ends (Yok).

DimensionBreak.description:
A gap in one of a dimension's lines where another object crosses it (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK), at the fraction `t` of
the line; its width the options' `breakSize`.

DimensionEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

angle.description: Linear: measured direction in degrees (0 = ΔY, 90 = ΔX).

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's (or tick's) length; absent: `DEFAULT_TICK` for ticks,
`DEFAULT_ARROW` for the others.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

breaks.description: The gaps in its lines where other objects cross them (docs/adr/0321 §1).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

c.description:
Angular: the vertex. Arc length: the arc's centre. Jogged: the centre
the line starts from (docs/adr/0147).

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

decimals.description:
A length's, a coordinate's or a slope's decimals; absent: the
project's length decimals (a slope's 2). Angles keep the project's.

dimLineColor.description:
The dimension line's and its arrowheads' colour, `#RRGGBB`; absent:
the object's (docs/adr/0205 §6).

dimLineType.description: The dimension line's type; absent: continuous.

dimLineWeight.description: The dimension line's weight, paper mm as an object's; absent: a hairline.

dimStyle.description: The project's dimension style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

extBeyond.description: How far the extension lines pass the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_BEYOND`.

extColor.description: The extension lines' colour; absent: the object's.

extLineType.description: The extension lines' type; absent: continuous.

extOffset.description: The extension lines' gap from the measured points; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_OFFSET`.

extWeight.description: The extension lines' weight, paper mm; absent: a hairline.

font.description: The value's typeface; absent: the project's.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

level.description:
A Kot's level (docs/adr/0721 §2): `za` is the level's elevation plus its offset, written again when the
level's elevation changes; absent: its own `za`. An elevation mark's only.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

mask.description:
The value is drawn over the drawing's background (docs/adr/0147, as a
text's mask, docs/adr/0145).

options.description: Where the value goes when it does not fit and how it is written (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

overrides.description:
The fields set apart from its style by hand (docs/adr/0322 §5), by name (`DIMENSION_OVERRIDES`): they keep
their value when the style changes. Empty: each field follows while it holds the style's old value.

prefix.description: Written before the value (and its kind's own prefix).

refs.description: The objects its points follow (docs/adr/0249): an associative dimension; none, free points.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

textColor.description: The value's colour; absent: the object's.

textGap.description: The value's baseline over the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_TEXT_GAP`.

textPlace.description: Where the value stands; absent: over the line.

textShift.description: Its value moved from its place (docs/adr/0321 §1).

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

unit.description: The unit lengths and coordinates are written in; absent: the project's.

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

za.description: Slope: the two points' elevations, metres (docs/adr/0147).

DimensionFit.description:
Where the value goes when it does not fit between the extension lines (AutoCAD's DIMATFIT and DIMTIX): absent,
always between them.

oneOf.description: Beyond the second extension line when the value and the two arrowheads are longer than the line between them.
Always beyond the second extension line, the arrowheads outside.

DimensionLevel.description:
A Kot (an elevation mark) bound to a level of the project (docs/adr/0721 §2): its value is the level's floor
elevation plus `offset` (a wet room's −0.02), written again whenever the level's elevation changes.

id.description: The level, by its id among the project's levels.

offset.description: Metres added to the level's elevation; absent: none.

DimensionLook.description:
A dimension's look from its style (docs/adr/0183 §3): the style it follows,
its arrowheads, its parts' sizes (times its value's height), where its
value stands and how the value is written. All absent: the look dimensions
always had, the value in the project's unit and decimals.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's (or tick's) length; absent: `DEFAULT_TICK` for ticks,
`DEFAULT_ARROW` for the others.

decimals.description:
A length's, a coordinate's or a slope's decimals; absent: the
project's length decimals (a slope's 2). Angles keep the project's.

dimLineColor.description:
The dimension line's and its arrowheads' colour, `#RRGGBB`; absent:
the object's (docs/adr/0205 §6).

dimLineType.description: The dimension line's type; absent: continuous.

dimLineWeight.description: The dimension line's weight, paper mm as an object's; absent: a hairline.

dimStyle.description: The project's dimension style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

extBeyond.description: How far the extension lines pass the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_BEYOND`.

extColor.description: The extension lines' colour; absent: the object's.

extLineType.description: The extension lines' type; absent: continuous.

extOffset.description: The extension lines' gap from the measured points; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_OFFSET`.

extWeight.description: The extension lines' weight, paper mm; absent: a hairline.

font.description: The value's typeface; absent: the project's.

options.description: Where the value goes when it does not fit and how it is written (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2).

overrides.description:
The fields set apart from its style by hand (docs/adr/0322 §5), by name (`DIMENSION_OVERRIDES`): they keep
their value when the style changes. Empty: each field follows while it holds the style's old value.

prefix.description: Written before the value (and its kind's own prefix).

textColor.description: The value's colour; absent: the object's.

textGap.description: The value's baseline over the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_TEXT_GAP`.

textPlace.description: Where the value stands; absent: over the line.

unit.description: The unit lengths and coordinates are written in; absent: the project's.

DimensionOptions.description: A dimension's options (docs/adr/0321 §1, §2): all absent, the dimension as it always was.

breakSize.description: A break's width, times the value's height, over 0; absent: 1 (AutoCAD's DIMBREAK size).

lengthStyle.description:
Feet and inches in an inch or foot unit (AutoCAD's DIMLUNIT, docs/adr/0262 §2); absent: the project's, unless
the dimension names its own unit.

round.description: Lengths and coordinates rounded to this increment, metres, over 0 (AutoCAD's DIMRND).

DimensionRefs.description: An associative dimension's references: what its points `a`, `b` and `c` follow; a point without one is free.

rule.description: How the points no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1); none, each bound point follows its place alone.

DimensionRule.description: How an associative dimension's points that no place names follow (docs/adr/0320 §1).

oneOf.description:
A radius's, a diameter's, a jogged radius's, an arc length's or an arc's angle: the bound points are on one
curve (a circle, an arc, a path's arc segment); its centre (a radius's `a`, the others' `c`) is the curve's.

An angle between two straight edges: `a` and `b` name the edges its arms lie on; its vertex `c` is where
their lines cross, each arm keeping its length and side.

An axis between two straight edges (docs/adr/0322): `a` and `b` name the edges; the axis runs from the middle
of their starts to the middle of their ends, the second edge turned to run the first's way.

A linear dimension along a cut (docs/adr/0711): the cut runs through `c` in the dimension's direction; a point
naming a straight edge is where the edge's line crosses the cut, another place is where it is; the
dimension's line stays where it is in the world.

DimensionSet.description: A live recipe with stable member identities and separate layout overrides.

at.description: First row placement in the world plane; never inferred from render lines.

edge.description:
The straight edge of the wall's path measured: vertex `edge` to `edge + 1` (a closed wall's last edge back to
its first vertex; docs/adr/0700). None: a two-point wall's only edge, as before (KCAD schema 113).

gapMm.description: Paper millimetres; model distance is gapMm * plotScale / 1000.

look.description: The new members' starting template; existing members retain manual looks.

scales.description:
The sheets' scales (1:n) the members are drawn at too, as large on paper as at the drawing's own, ascending
(docs/adr/0730 §1); none: the recipe leaves the members' annotative representations alone.

span.description: A façade or a space measured along a direction (docs/adr/0729); none: one wall's edge (docs/adr/0695/0700).

suppressed.description: Explicitly removed segments stay removed until the user restores them.

tight.description: A value that does not fit between its extension lines: kept in its place or shifted (docs/adr/0730 §2).

DimensionSetBreak.description: Why a recipe cannot currently generate a trustworthy complete chain.

oneOf.description: A façade's walls on different architectural levels now (docs/adr/0729 §3).

DimensionSetFace.description: A real wall face, relative to the direction of its source path.

DimensionSetMember.description: An active segment's ordinary dimension. Unchanged active pairs keep this id.

shift.description:
Where the recipe last placed the value at the drawing's own scale (docs/adr/0730 §2); none: in its place. A value
whose place differs from it was moved by the user and keeps its place.

DimensionSetOpenings.description: Opening references are rough jamb corners, or their actual centre.

DimensionSetReference.description: Which of a wall's lines a façade or space recipe measures (docs/adr/0729 §1).

oneOf.description: Its two faces.
The two boundaries of its strongest components' band (its faces without components).

DimensionSetRow.description:
The adjacent wall/opening intervals, or the source wall's whole length; a façade's or a space's walls and grids
(docs/adr/0729).

oneOf.description: The walls' thicknesses, the walls meeting a façade, a space's holes: a `span` recipe's only.
The grids across a façade or a space: a `span` recipe's only.

DimensionSetRowPlace.description: A row manually placed in world coordinates; source edits keep this override.

DimensionSetSegment.description: A semantic segment, independent of its current order and coordinates.

DimensionSetSpan.description: A recipe over a group of walls (a façade) or a space's outline, along one direction (docs/adr/0729 §1).

direction.description: The unit direction measured along, in the world plane.

level.description: The sources' architectural level; none when they have none.

space.description: The recipe's `wall` is a space: its outline is measured.

walls.description: A façade's further walls, after the recipe's `wall`, in the user's order; none for a space.

DimensionSetTight.description: What a recipe does with a value that does not fit between its extension lines (docs/adr/0730 §2).

oneOf.description: In its place, drawn in the danger tone (docs/adr/0729 §6).
Beside its interval, else above or below its line, where no other value or row's line is.

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

Merkez işareti (KCAD schema 62, docs/adr/0322): the cross at the centre `a` of the curve through `b`, `height`
across, turned `angle` degrees from `a`→`b`; its axis lines reach `offset` past the curve.

Eksen çizgisi (docs/adr/0322): the axis between two straight edges, from `a` to `b` (the middles of their
matched ends), `offset` past each end.
Kot (docs/adr/0322): the elevation `za` of the point `a`, its mark on `a` and its value on the shoulder at `b`.

DimensionStyleDef.description: A named dimension style (docs/adr/0183 §3): sizes in paper mm.

arrowSize.description: The arrowhead's length, mm; absent: the arrowhead's default times the height.

dimLineColor.description: The line fields as a dimension's (docs/adr/0205 §6); weights in paper mm.

height.description: The value's height on paper, mm.

id.description: One of its kind among the project's dimension styles (a UUIDv7).

name.description: As a text style's.

textStyle.description:
The project text style its value is written in, by its name (AutoCAD's DIMTXSTY, docs/adr/1023): when that
style's font is an embedded SHX file, the font draws the value; otherwise `font` stays the value's typeface
(a DXF's reader sets both). Schema 186.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DimensionTolerance.description: A tolerance (AutoCAD's DIMTOL and DIMLIM), metres; lengths and coordinates only.

lower.description: Below the value, 0 or more; a deviation's and limits' (absent: 0).

DimensionZeros.description: Which zeros the number leaves out (AutoCAD's DIMZIN).

oneOf.description: The zero before the point: `0.50` → `.50`.
The decimals' trailing zeros, and a bare point: `2.500` → `2.5`, `4.000` → `4`.

DistanceAxis.description: Which way a distance is measured: along the line between its points, or across or along the drawing's axes.

oneOf.description: Along east: `b`'s east minus `a`'s.
Along north: `b`'s north minus `a`'s.

DocCheckItem.description: A document the kind is usually sent with, and whether the package has one.

round.description: The newest package it counts: the one being prepared, or the last sent (every package sent counts).

DoorSource.description: The doors' layer and which of its attributes say what.

code.description: Adres kodu (UAVT): a query that is one finds its door.

door.description: Kapı no: the outer door number (“12”, “12/A”).

layer.description: The layer's id. A layer the project no longer has is said when the locator is built.

street.description: Yol: the street's name, with its kind as written (“Atatürk Bulvarı”).

DossierAction.description: A step a side takes; which ones the caller may take now is in [`DossierDetail::actions`].

DossierActionRequest.description:
`POST /v1/dossiers/{id}/actions`. `expectedStatus` is the status the caller saw: another's step in between is a
conflict, not an overwrite.

attachments.description: Files uploaded as attachments, sent with the note.

dueSoon.description: With a legal deadline passed or within three days.

assignees.description: Members the dossier may be assigned to (municipality side, editors and above).

canAddFiles.description: Whether the caller prepares the next package now (files may be added to it).

canAssessFees.description:
Whether the caller issues fees on it and records their payment (docs/adr/9003): the municipality's editors and
above, on an open application.

canCancelFees.description: Whether the caller cancels its fees: the municipality's project managers and above.

canDelete.description: Whether the caller may remove the draft.

canEdit.description: Whether the caller may change its title, kind, place and the like now.

canImport.description:
Whether the caller may open a KentOS project file of it as a project: a professional in their own space, a
member who may create projects in the organisation (project manager and above).

canLinkLiveProject.description: Whether the caller links a live project to it: the municipality's project managers, while it is open.

canShareWithOffice.description: The caller is its responsible professional and may share it with an office of theirs or take it back.

canSign.description:
Whether the caller e-signs its files (docs/adr/9004): the professional's side who prepares it (an office's
editors too), the municipality's editors and above. Whether the server has a signing key is
`GET /v1/signing/trust`'s answer.

feeCount.description: Its assessments not cancelled (issued or paid).

liveProject.description: The municipality's live project the transfer is worked on in, instead of a copy (docs/adr/9000 §24).

oneOf.description: A professional to a municipality.
A municipality to a professional.

DossierEdit.description: `PATCH /v1/dossiers/{id}`: what its sending side changes while it is theirs to change.

DossierFileFromUpload.description: `POST /v1/dossiers/{id}/files/from-upload`: a received upload becomes a dossier's file.

docType.description: A document type of the portal's catalogue (`GET /v1/portal/catalog`); absent: found from the name.

purpose.description: `package` (the application's or the delivery's documents) or `attachment` (with the next message).

DossierFileImport.description: `POST /v1/dossiers/{id}/files/{file}/import`: a KCAD file of the dossier as a new cloud project.

tenantId.description: Where it goes: the caller's personal space when absent.

isProject.description: A KentOS project file (KCAD): it opens as a project.

scan.description: How far it was checked when it arrived.

state.description: `pending` (may still be removed) or `final` (sent, kept as it was).

DossierList.description: `GET …/dossiers`: a page of them, and how many there are.

DossierLiveProjectSet.description: `PUT /v1/dossiers/{id}/live-project`: the project to link (one of the municipality's), or none to unlink.

DossierOfficeSet.description:
`PUT /v1/dossiers/{id}/office`: the responsible professional shares the dossier with an office, or takes it back
(`null`).

DossierOrganization.description: The organisation side of a dossier, as both sides see it.

DossierRound.description: One package as it was sent.

DossierSide.description: The two sides of a dossier.

DossierSignatureView.description: `GET /v1/dossiers/{id}/signatures`: a verified signature kept on a file of the dossier.

round.description: The file's round (0: not sent yet).

side.description: The side of the person who signed.

signedAt.description: RFC 3339: when the card signed (the client's clock).

signerName.description: The KentOS account that delivered it.

stillMatches.description: Whether the file's stored bytes still have the digest that was signed.

verifiedAt.description: RFC 3339: when the server verified it.

DossierSite.description: Where the matter is; what was given of it.

archived.description: Closed and moved to the archive after its period (docs/adr/9000 §21): kept, out of the working lists.

awaitingMe.description: Whether it is waiting for the caller's side.

officeId.description: The office the professional shares it with (docs/adr/9000 §18), by id and name.

DraftParcel.description:
A parcel a draft would make: its area, identity and stated area as read when drafted, its rings as drawn then and the
lengths the document states.

DraftRing.description:
A draft's ring as its area was when drafted: its part, whether a hole, its vertices and each edge's bulge (none: all
straight).

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

oneOf.description: The inch, 0.0254 m exactly (docs/adr/0262 §1).
The international foot, 0.3048 m exactly.

actions.description: Applied in this order to the definition's objects, each on what the ones before left.

parameterGroups.description:
Ordered presentation groups. Unassigned parameters retain their automatic headings;
membership never changes the evaluator's parameter/action order or instance values.

typeParameters.description: Shared scalar parameter names. Scope belongs to this drawing definition, not a publication ID.

typeValues.description: Common inputs and calculated caches; geometric defaults remain action reference coordinates.

ElementRef.description: A part of an object by the object's persistent id.

EllipseEntity.description: DXF ELLIPSE: centre, major axis vector, minor/major ratio, parameters t0 → t1.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

Ellipsoid.description: An ellipsoid: its name, semi-major axis (m) and inverse flattening.

EmsalCount.description: How a room counts for the floor area ratio (docs/adr/8030; Planlı Alanlar İmar Yönetmeliği 5/8, 21, 22).

oneOf.description: Emsale dahil: the floors' area (katlar alanı).
Emsal harici (22/1): out of it, but together at most 30 % of the parcel's emsal area (5/8); what passes goes in.

Emsal harici, %30'a sayılmaz (5/8's own list: fire stairs and their halls, a shelter or plant room in the
basement …).

Entity.description: Any drawing object, tagged by `kind` as in the TypeScript model.

oneOf.description: A general NURBS curve: degree, control points, weights and knots (docs/adr/0259).
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144).
An arrow with a note (docs/adr/0146).
Rows and columns of cells (docs/adr/0184).
A picture (docs/adr/0192).
An orthophoto, a scanned sheet or an elevation model (docs/adr/0204).
A point cloud: LAS, LAZ, COPC or text files (docs/adr/0207).
A wall (docs/adr/0339): its path, width, justification and components; its faces drawn from them.

A door, a window or a bare opening in a wall (docs/adr/0341): its wall's id, its place along it and its
jambs' points.
A slab (docs/adr/0722): a floor, a balcony or a terrace: its outline, thickness, top and free sides' edge.
A grid (docs/adr/0343): its line, label and bubbles.
A column (docs/adr/0343): its centre, outline and the grids it stands on.
A beam (docs/adr/8041 §1): its axis, its web's width and height, its top; drawn dashed in a plan.
A roof (docs/adr/8044 §1): its eaves line and each edge's slope; drawn by its faces' lines in a plan.

A railing (docs/adr/8045 §3): its line, its height, its top rail's width and its infill; its top rail drawn as two
thin lines in a plan.
A stair (docs/adr/0343): its walking line and its risers, treads and landings.
A ramp (docs/adr/0343): its centre line, width, rise and landings.
A tag (docs/adr/0344): its object, its words and frame.
A view mark (docs/adr/0345): a section, elevation or detail mark pointing at a view.

A record without a geometry (docs/adr/0410): a table's row, with the base's attributes,
attachments and label; not drawn, picked or snapped to.

EventBlock.description: One block definition an event changed (docs/adr/0144 §5).

EventLink.description: A link: the events of one layer on the routes of some others.

eventRoute.description: The events' attribute naming their route.

events.description: The event layer's id: the objects it holds are the events (points, or lines and polylines).

from.description: A line event's from and to measure attributes (`line` only, and then both required).

id.description: Letters, digits, `-`, `_`, `.`; 1–64; unique in the project.

measure.description: A point event's measure attribute (`point` only, and then required).

name.description: What the windows show; trimmed, 1–64 characters.

offset.description: The attribute of the offset from the route (m, perpendicular); none: the event is on the route.

routeField.description: The routes' id field: a route is the first object of an id.

routes.description: The route layers' ids (1–16, none twice, none the event layer).

side.description: The side a positive offset lies on; written only when not `right`.

tolerance.description: How far (m) an event may lie from its route's place before a write moves it; none: 0,001.

EventLinkKind.description: What an event object is: a point at a measure, or a line between two.

oneOf.description: A point at one measure (`measure`).
A line or a polyline from one measure to another (`from`, `to`).

next.description: Cursor to ask from next time (the last seq, or the given one when nothing is new).

EventRecord.description: One committed change of a project, in commit order (`seq` is the cursor).

blocks.description:
Block definitions made, changed or removed (docs/adr/0144 §5): a
client takes them with `GET …/blocks`.

kind.description:
`project.changes`; `project.deleted` (moved to the trash; no objects;
nothing is committed after it); `project.access` (a grant changed; no
objects); `project.archived`, `project.unarchived`, `project.restored`
and `project.metadata` (the catalog, docs/adr/0028; no objects).

meta.description: Name, settings, layer tree or styles changed.

requestId.description: The request that made it: a client recognises its own commits.

EventSide.description: Which side of the route a positive offset lies on.

oneOf.description: The right of the measure's direction.
The left of it.

ExtensionPin.description:
The extension an extension's tool came from when it was chosen (docs/adr/8057 §12, §13): a form's action, a
model's step. The package's content digest covers the tool's descriptor, its code, its environment's lock and the
capabilities it asks for.

digest.description: Its package's content digest then: `sha256:` and 64 lower-case hex digits.

ExtractAreaUnit.description: An area's unit (CLAUDE.md §5: a dönüm 1000 m², a hectare 10000 m²).

decimals.description:
A quantity's decimals; absent: the project's (lengths' for a length or a dimension, areas' for an area, 0 for
a count, the column's it multiplies for a computed one).

label.description: Its heading; a quantity's unit is written after it in brackets (`Uzunluk (m)`). Not empty, one line.

ExtractJoin.description:
A description table joined to the rows (docs/adr/1030 §5): a CSV, XLSX or ODS file's sheet whose first row names
its columns; its row whose `key` column reads as a row's `on` column is that row's.

key.description: The file's key column's heading: its words unique and not empty on every row.

on.description: The recipe's column (by index, a word column not joined) whose words are looked up.

path.description: Its path, absolute or from the drawing's folder.

ExtractRead.description:
A source an extraction table was written from, as last read: a drawing or the joined file by its path as the
recipe gives it and the SHA-256 of its bytes.

ExtractSort.description: A sort key: a column by index, up or down.

ExtractValue.description: What a column writes of an occurrence (docs/adr/1030 §4).

oneOf.description: The drawing it is in: its file's name, Bu çizim for the open one.
Its kind's Turkish name (Blok, Çizgi …; Dizi for an array counted whole).
Its block's name; empty for another kind.
Its effective layer's name.

A dynamic block's variant: its parameter values that differ from the defaults, `name=value` by name, `; `
between; empty for the defaults and for another kind.
An attribute's effective value (a constant's, the insert's, the definition's default) or the object's datum.
Adet: one an occurrence.
Uzunluk: a curve's length (a closed one's perimeter, an area's with its holes), placed as it is drawn.
Alan: a closed object's area net of its holes, placed as it is drawn.
Gerçek ölçü: a length dimension's measured value from its geometry (never its written text).
Yazılan: a dimension's text as shown (words, never summed).
Elle yazılmış: whether a dimension's text overrides its measure (evet, hayır).

Hesaplanan: an earlier quantity column (by index) times `factor` (a decimal number, `.` before its fraction),
in `unit` (one line; may be empty for a pure number).
A joined table's column by its heading (the join's row whose key is this row's key column's words).

blocks.description: The blocks whose inserts are taken, by name (Turkish case folded as block names are); none named: every block.

columns.description: The columns, in order; at least one, at most [`MAX_EXTRACT_COLUMNS`].

current.description: The open drawing is read (default yes).

drawings.description:
Other drawings read (read only: never saved nor changed): `.kcad` or KentOS JSON paths, absolute or from the
drawing's folder; each once, at most [`MAX_EXTRACT_DRAWINGS`].

group.description: Alike rows one (Benzer satırları birleştir): rows whose word columns read the same, their quantities summed.

join.description: A description table joined by a key (Dış veriyle eşle).

kinds.description: The kinds taken ([`EXTRACT_KINDS`]); none named: inserts.

layers.description:
The layers whose objects are taken, by name (an object's effective layer: a block's piece on the block's layer
is on its insert's); none named: every layer.

name.description: Its name (Tarif adı); not empty, one line, at most 100 letters.

sort.description: The rows' order: by these columns in turn; ties keep the reading order.

total.description: A last row, Toplam, with every quantity column's sum.

FeatureConflict.description: Why one object could not be saved, with the server's current copy to show the difference.

FeatureFeed.description: Where a layer's objects came from, to take them again (docs/adr/0208 §10).

bbox.description: The area asked, `[x₁, y₁, x₂, y₂]` in the project's system; absent: all.

key.description: The attribute that matches objects when they are taken again.

name.description: WFS's type, OGC's collection, ArcGIS's layer.

srid.description: The system asked of the service.

FeaturePage.description: `GET …/features?after=&limit=`: a page in id order; `next` is the cursor of the following page.

FeatureRecord.description: One stored object. `entity.id` is meaningless on the wire (the browser numbers objects itself).

FeeAssess.description: `POST /v1/dossiers/{id}/fees/preview` and `…/fees`: the values for the active tariff's inputs.

dueOn.description: When it is to be paid by, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

FeeAssessment.description: A tariff applied to a dossier.

paymentNote.description: How to pay, from the tariff.

oneOf.description: Issued (tahakkuk): to be paid.

FeeDefinition.description: A tariff's content: what it asks, its tables and its items.

paymentNote.description: How to pay, shown to the professional (bank, IBAN, the cash office).

FeeItem.description: One fee or charge of the tariff.

appliesTo.description: The dossier kinds it applies to; none: every kind.

beforeDecision.description: Paid before the dossier's decision (2464 Ek Madde 5: before the permit).

condition.description: Applies only when this is true (`değil @kamu_binasi`); none: always.

group.description: `harç` (a fee of the law) or `ücret` (a charge of the council's tariff, 2464 m.97); shown as the line's group.

legalBasis.description: What it rests on (“2464 sayılı Kanun Ek Madde 1 ve 6”).

vatPercent.description: VAT on top, percent (a fee of the law carries none).

basis.description: How it was found, in words: “152 m² × 3,75 TL (Konut, 151–200 m²)”.

FeeParameter.description: An input the tariff's items read: in a formula and a condition as `@key`.

key.description: Lower-case letters, digits and `_`, starting with a letter (`insaat_alani`).

required.description: Asked of the staff on every assessment; one not given makes the assessment refused.

oneOf.description: A number (an area, a volume, a count), in its `unit`.
One of `choices` (a building's use, a zone).
Yes or no (an exemption).

FeePreview.description: What a preview gives: the lines and why some inputs are missing, nothing saved.

missing.description: Inputs not given or not valid, by key, with why.

parameters.description: The inputs the dossier's kind needs, to ask.

FeeRounding.description: How amounts are rounded, line by line.

oneOf.description: To the kuruş, half up.
Down to whole lira.
To the nearest lira, half up.

FeeRule.description: How an item's amount is found.

oneOf.description: A fixed amount (maktu), TL.
A number input times a rate: the rate a table gives, or a single rate.
Any formula over `@inputs` and `@tables`, in the expression language (`@alan * @birim * 1.5`).

decision.description:
The decision it carries out (“Meclis kararı 2025/245, 12.12.2025”): the council's tariff for the charges (2464
m.97); the fees' amounts are the law's and the decision for the municipality's group (m.95, m.96/A), revalued.

FeeScheduleCopy.description: `POST …/fees/schedules/{id}/copy`: next year's tariff from this one.

factor.description: Every rate, fixed amount and bound times this (the year's revaluation: `1.25` for a 25 % rise).

FeeScheduleEdit.description: `POST`/`PUT …/fees/schedules`: a tariff as it is written.

FeeScheduleState.description: Where a tariff is in its life.

oneOf.description: Being written; not applied to dossiers.
The one applied to new assessments while its dates hold.
Replaced; its assessments keep it.

FeeTable.description: A rate table: the first row whose choice and bracket match gives the rate; in a formula as `@<key>`.

by.description: The choice parameter the rows' `when` is matched with, if any.

quantity.description: The number parameter the rows' brackets are matched with, if any.

FeeTableRow.description: A rate for a choice's value and a quantity's bracket; an empty `when` or bound matches every value.

from.description: Inclusive bounds of the quantity (`101`–`120` m²).

minRate.description: The bounds the rate must stay within, when given: the law's “en az – en çok” (2464 Ek Madde 6, m.84).

rate.description: TL per unit of the quantity.

FeeTry.description:
`POST /v1/tenants/{tenant}/fees/try`: what a tariff (saved or not, e.g. a draft being edited) makes of a dossier
kind's inputs; nothing is saved.

kind.description: The dossier kind (`building_permit`, …): the items that apply to it.

FeedKind.description: What a layer's objects were taken from (docs/adr/0208 §10).

oneOf.description: An ArcGIS REST layer's `query`.
A GeoJSON document at an address.

FieldBroken.description: Why a field's value cannot be read.

oneOf.description: The object is gone.
The object has no such value (an open object's area, a line's text).
The attribute or the variable named is not there.
Texts whose fields read each other in a ring.

FieldChoice.description:
One value of a field's value list: the code written to the attribute
and the label shown for it.

description.description: What the value means, said beside it in a list (docs/adr/0438 §5): 1–500 characters.

from.description:
The first day the value holds (`YYYY-AA-GG`, docs/adr/0438 §5); before it a new choice does not
offer it, as a retired one.

retired.description:
Kullanımdan kalktı (docs/adr/0418): a record that holds it keeps it and shows it, a new
choice does not offer it, a form does not write it anew. Written only as `true`.

until.description: The last day the value holds (`YYYY-AA-GG`); after it a new choice does not offer it.

FieldColumn.description: A bound table's column as its field keeps it (docs/adr/0753).

check.description:
The table's CHECK constraint that ties the column to a list of values (docs/adr/0755 §4), by its name or, for one
without a name, its text: the field's values are that list, read again with every reading of the table.

made.description:
The value the table makes itself, as its SQL text: a default it works out for a new row (`now()`, `uuidv7()`,
`nextval('…')`; docs/adr/0753 §2), an identity's clause (`GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY`, `GENERATED ALWAYS
