speed.description: A speed cost's speed (km/h) where the field gives none it can read.

unit.description: A field cost's unit (“TL”, “dk”); a speed cost's is minutes and names none.

oneOf.description: Süre, minutes: the length over the speed.
The field's value for the whole edge, shared by its pieces by their lengths.

closed.description: An expression: the edges it holds for are out of service, travelled by nothing.

closures.description:
Tarihli kapanmalar (docs/adr/0567 §2): the edge fields of the first and the last day an edge is closed; a
question with a date passes none closed that day. None: no edge is closed by date.

costs.description: The costs besides the length, in the order the tools offer them.

edges.description: The line layers whose lines, paths and arcs are the edges, in this order.

id.description: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens; one of its kind in the project.

junctions.description: The point layers whose points are junctions, sources or valves.

levels.description:
Seviyeler (docs/adr/0521 §3): which ends and insides of the edges connect, by their level fields; none: every
one at one level.

name.description: Trimmed; one of its kind in the project.

profiles.description:
Araç profilleri (docs/adr/0567 §1): what a vehicle may travel (its weight, height, width against the edges'
limits; the edges its kind may not) and how fast; a question names one. None: every vehicle the same.

subnetworks.description:
Alt ağlar (docs/adr/0557 §2): the parts the sources feed, found by `cad.subnetworks.find` and written into an
attribute by `cad.subnetworks.update`. None: the network has no subnetworks.

terminals.description:
Terminaller (docs/adr/0557 §1): the ends of a device (a valve's in and out, a transformer's two sides) and which
of them connect through it; a trace goes through a device only along those paths. None: a device is a point.

turns.description: Dönüşler (docs/adr/0521 §2): forbidden turns, U-turns and turn delays; none: every turn free.

oneOf.description: Every edge both ways.
Every edge the way it is drawn (pipes drawn with the flow).

By an attribute's value: `forward` the way the edge is drawn only, `backward` against it only, `closed`
neither; any other value, and none, both ways.

NetworkKind.description: Yol ağı or Şebeke: what the tools offer first; the graph is the same.

NetworkLayer.description: An edge layer and, optionally, which of its objects are edges.

filter.description: An expression: only the objects it holds for; absent: all of them.

layer.description: The layer's id. A layer the project no longer has is said when the network is built.

NetworkLevels.description:
The level fields (docs/adr/0521 §3): an edge's level at its start, at its end and, when given, inside it (else
its ends' when they are one, none when they differ); a junction point's from `start` (empty: every level).

NetworkPeriod.description:
A period of a speed cost's day (docs/adr/0521 §4): from `from` to `to` (minutes of the day), the edges go at their
speed times `factor`, or at the speed `field` gives (km/h; 0 closed, empty or unreadable the edge's own speed).

NetworkProfile.description:
A vehicle profile (docs/adr/0567 §1): its name, its limits (an edge is closed to it where the edge's field is
below its value), what forbids an edge to it (a field's values), its top speed and whether it goes against one-way
edges (a pedestrian).

bothWays.description: Whether the vehicle goes both ways on one-way edges (closed edges stay closed).

name.description: Trimmed, at most 40 characters; one of its kind in the network, Turkish case aside.

topSpeed.description: The highest speed (km/h) the vehicle goes on any edge: a speed cost's edges slower; none: the edges' own.

NetworkSubnetworks.description:
A network's subnetworks (docs/adr/0557 §2): its sources are the subnetwork controllers; a subnetwork is what a
controller reaches (not past another controller, a closed junction or a closed edge).

attribute.description:
The attribute `cad.subnetworks.update` writes on every object of the network: its subnetworks' names, joined
with `; ` where it is in more than one; taken away where it is in none.

keepCurrent.description:
Güncel tut (docs/adr/0562 §3): a write that touches the network's layers also rewrites the attribute, in its
own step; when it cannot, the command says `subnetwork_dirty`.

name.description: The controller's attribute holding its subnetwork's name; none: its label, else its `Ad`, else `Kaynak <no>`.

NetworkTerminals.description:
The terminals of a network's devices (docs/adr/0557 §1): the edge fields naming the terminal an edge's start and
its end are attached to, and the devices.

devices.description: The devices: 1–16, each a junction layer of the network.

start.description: The edge attribute whose value (a terminal's id or name) is the terminal its start is attached to.

NetworkTurns.description:
A network's turns (docs/adr/0521 §2): where a way may turn back, what a turn at a crossing of three or more
pieces costs by its angle (seconds, added to the speed costs), and the turn layers' lines, each a turn from the
edge at its start to the edge at its end through their common node: forbidden, or its own delay.

back.description: A U-turn, wherever it is made, seconds.

straight.description: Going straight on (within 30° of the way one came), seconds.

oneOf.description: Her yerde: at every node.
Yalnız çıkmazlarda: where one piece ends (a dead end).
Hiçbir yerde.

NewOwner.description: The first owner of a new organisation: an existing account, or a new one.

NotificationSettings.description: `GET /v1/me/notification-settings`: how the account's notifications also reach it, and what reached it lately.

email.description: The account's own choice: e-mail too (on unless turned off).

emailAddress.description: Where the e-mails go: the account's address; none, no e-mail.

emailOffered.description: Whether the platform sends e-mail at all.

emailVerified.description: Only a verified address gets e-mail: an unverified one is whoever typed it.

recent.description: The account's last deliveries, newest first.

sms.description: SMS too (off until turned on with a number).

phone.description: `+905321234567` or `05321234567`; spaces, dashes and brackets are dropped. Needed for SMS.

tenantSlug.description: The organisation a member opens it in; none for a professional's own.

NumberRule.description:
The values a number parameter may take: within `min` and `max`, on `step`s from `min` (from 0 without one), one
of `list`; or computed by `expression` from the other number parameters (it is not set then).

NurbsEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

closed.description: Its ends meet (AutoCAD's flag 1); the source's word, kept as written.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

fit.description: The points it was drawn through, kept with it; the control points are the source.

fitTolerance.description: How far the curve may pass from its fit points, ≥ 0 (AutoCAD's 44).

knots.description:
The knot vector: `ctrl.len() + degree + 1` numbers, never decreasing;
the curve runs over `knots[degree] .. knots[ctrl.len()]`, which is not empty.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

tangents.description: The fit points' start and end tangent directions; null where none was given.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

weights.description: Each control point's weight, above 0; absent: all 1 (not rational).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

ObjectValue.description: An object's value a field writes.

oneOf.description: A closed object's area, its holes taken off.
A closed object's perimeter.
A line's, an arc's, a path's or a curve's length.
Its layer's name.
Its label.
The attribute named: a block insert's attribute value, else the object's attribute.
A text's letters (a cross reference).
Its east and north: a point's place, a text's, a block's or a table's insertion point, else where its label goes.

ObstacleKind.description: What of an obstacle area a label avoids.

oneOf.description: Its inside: a label covering any of it.
Its outline: a label crossing an edge.

label.description: Button text, e.g. the organisation's name.

startUrl.description: Where the browser goes to start (`/v1/auth/oidc/start`).

OpeningAnchor.description: Which point of the opening `at` names, along its wall's base line.

oneOf.description: Its jamb nearer the wall's start.
Its jamb nearer the wall's end.

OpeningBreak.description: Why an opening is not where its wall says (docs/adr/0341 §3): it stays, drawn from its jambs, until it is fixed.

oneOf.description: Its wall is gone, or is no wall.
It runs past its wall's end or round one of its corners.
It runs into another opening of its wall.
A niche or flue deeper than its wall is thick (docs/adr/0719 §3).

OpeningBuild.description: A door's or window's construction (docs/adr/0772 §3), each field optional; none given draws it as before.

bothSides.description:
A folding door's panels fold to both jambs, half to each (an even count; docs/adr/0777 §3). Absent: all to the
jamb at its `hand`.

casing.description: Its casing (pervaz, söve) on both wall faces beside each jamb, its width, metres; absent: none.

drum.description:
A revolving door's drum, its inside diameter, metres (docs/adr/0777 §1); absent: the light between the frame's
sides. At most the light.

fit.description: The fitting gap between the rough opening and the frame, each side, metres; absent: none.

frameDepth.description: The frame's depth across the wall, metres; absent: the wall's thickness.

frameOffset.description: With `frameDepth`: the frame's distance from the wall face it opens to (`side`), metres; absent: centred.

leafThickness.description: A leaf's thickness, metres; absent: drawn as a line, the net clear width reads 0.04 m.

lip.description: How much of an open pocket door's leaf stays out of its pocket, metres (docs/adr/0777 §2); absent: 0.05.

mullions.description: A window's mullions (dikey kayıt): its panes are one more; absent: none.

overlap.description:
How much a two-leaf sliding door's or window's leaves overlap when shut, metres (docs/adr/0777 §4); absent: 5 %
of the light. Below the light.

sillBoard.description: A window's sill board (denizlik), how far it reaches past the face opposite the side it opens to, metres.

sizeBy.description: Which width its nominal size names; absent: the rough opening.

split.description: Two unequal leaves: the hinge-start leaf's share of the light, above 0, below 1; absent: halves.

threshold.description: A door's threshold (eşik), its depth across the wall, metres; absent: none.

track.description:
A sliding door's or window's track drawn in plan: the rail its leaves run on, and a one-leaf door's leaf beside
the wall face, over the stretch it slides to (docs/adr/0777 §4). Absent: not drawn.

tracks.description:
A three- or four-leaf sliding door's or window's tracks, 2 or 3 (docs/adr/0792 §1): the leaves from the jamb
they stack at, one per track, slide over the first; those past the tracks stay. Absent: 2.

transoms.description: A window's transoms (yatay kayıt); plan does not show them, schedules and tags do.

useZone.description: The use zone in front of it on the side it opens to (kullanım alanı), its depth, metres; absent: none.

at.description: The distance along its wall's base line, from its start, to its `anchor`.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

broken.description: Why it is not where its wall says; absent: it is.

build.description:
Its construction (docs/adr/0772 §2, §3): sizes, leaves, frame, threshold, casing, sill board, panes, use zone.
Absent: drawn and measured as before.

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

depth.description:
A niche's depth from its face, a flue's size across its wall, metres (docs/adr/0719); none for one that goes
through. Its face is `side`.

frame.description: Its frame's width at each jamb, along the wall, metres. Absent: none.

hand.description: Its hinge's end. Absent: its start.

head.description: Its head's height above the floor, metres.

inset.description: A flue's distance from its face (`side`) to its cavity, metres; absent: centred in its wall (docs/adr/0719).

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

leaves.description: Its leaves, 1 or 2; a revolving door's wings 3 or 4, a folding door's panels 2 to 6 (docs/adr/0777). Absent: 1.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

overrides.description: The fields of its type it keeps its own value of (örnek istisnası), in the order the fields are listed.

phase.description:
Its own phase (docs/adr/8039 §1): a new door cut into an existing wall, an existing window closed up. Absent:
its wall's.

place.description:
Its jambs: the start jamb's points on its wall's left and right face, then the end jamb's; written from its
wall by the document.

showSwing.description: The swing's arc is drawn. Absent: it is.

side.description: The side it opens to. Absent: the path's left.

sill.description: Its sill's height above the floor, metres.

style.description: The opening type it was made with, by its id (`builtin_opening_types`).

swing.description: How far a leaf swings open, degrees, above 0, at most 180. Absent: 90.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

typeVersion.description:
The version of the project type `style` names it last took (docs/adr/0772 §1): it follows that type. Absent: it
follows none (a KentOS type's values copied once, or none).

width.description: The rough opening in the wall, jamb to jamb, metres.

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

oneOf.description: Kapı.
Pencere.
Boşluk: a gap in the wall and nothing in it.
Niş: a recess cut from one face of the wall, `depth` into it (docs/adr/0719).
Baca: a cavity inside the wall, clear of both faces (docs/adr/0719).

OpeningHand.description: An end of the opening along its wall: where its hinge is.

oneOf.description: At its jamb nearer the wall's start.
Kanatlı: about a hinge.
Sürme: along the wall.
Sabit: it does not open.
Döner (docs/adr/0777 §1): 3 or 4 wings turning about the middle of a drum (`build.drum`).

Cebe giren (docs/adr/0777 §2): its leaves slide into a pocket inside the wall, beside the jamb at its `hand`
(both jambs for two leaves).
Katlanır (docs/adr/0777 §3): 2 to 6 panels folding to the jamb at its `hand` (both with `build.bothSides`).

OpeningSide.description: A side of its wall's base line: where its leaves open to.

OpeningSizeBy.description: Which of an opening's widths its nominal size names (docs/adr/0772 §2).

oneOf.description: Kaba boşluk: the hole in the wall, jamb to jamb (an opening's `width`).
Kasa dış eni: the product's outer width, the rough opening less the fitting gap each side.
Kanat eni: the light inside the frame, the leaves' width.

OpeningType.description: An office's or a project's door or window type (docs/adr/0772 §1).

id.description: Its lasting key: lower-case letters, digits and `-`, at most 64, not starting with `kentos-` (KentOS's own).

material.description:
Its frame's and leaves' make (kasa ve kanat; docs/adr/8038, Planlı Alanlar İmar Yönetmeliği 57(29)): “PVC, 5
odacıklı; çift camlı Low-E 4+16+4”, as the joinery list says it. One line, at most 200 letters; absent: not said
(KCAD schema 229).

name.description: What it is called (K01): unique in the project, case aside.

source.description: Where it came from: the office library's name it was taken from; absent: made in this project.

uValue.description:
Its thermal transmittance, W/m²K (a window's Up; the maker's figure, TS EN ISO 10077): a window's above TS
825:2024's 1.8 is a finding (docs/adr/8038). Above 0, at most 10; absent: not said (KCAD schema 229).

version.description: Each change gives it the next; an opening that took an older one is behind (eski sürüm).

OpeningTypeField.description:
A field a type governs: an opening following the type takes it, unless the opening keeps its own (docs/adr/0772 §1).
The form is the type's own and never an exception; an opening's place, wall, hand, side and number are its own.

oneOf.description: A three- or four-leaf sliding door's tracks (docs/adr/0792).

OptionChoice.description: A view's choice of one set's option (docs/adr/0788 §3): the set's id and the option's.

OptionCombo.description:
A named combination of options (docs/adr/0808; Archicad's Design Option Combination): one option for some of the
project's sets; a set it does not name shows its primary. A proposal (“Teklif 1: mutfak B, banyo A”) is one
combination; a view's recipe may show it, Bileşimi uygula makes its choices the primaries.

OptionSet.description: A set of alternatives for one part of the plan, one of them primary (the one the drawing shows).

primary.description: The id of the option the drawing shows.

OrganizationCategory.description: What an organisation is to the portal: a municipality takes applications and transfers projects.

OrganizationPortal.description: `GET/PUT /v1/tenants/{tenant}/portal`: an organisation's portal settings and seats.

ParagraphLayout.description:
A multi-line text's indents, tab stops and columns (docs/adr/0324 §1), in its height (MTEXT's `\p` codes):
every paragraph's first line starts `leftIndent + indent` heights from the box's left, its other lines
`leftIndent`; a tab goes to the next stop past where it is, a stop every `DEFAULT_TAB` heights after the last
given; columns take the lines in turn, each `columns.height` metres tall.

columns.description: Static columns; a text in columns has a box.

engine.description: Explicit metric/glyph profile; absent: the existing legacy layout.

indent.description: A paragraph's first line from the others', heights; below 0 a hanging indent (a list's). Absent: 0.

leftIndent.description: Every line but a paragraph's first from the box's left, heights. Absent: 0.

tabs.description: The tab stops from the box's left, heights, ascending, each over 0.

ParamValue.description:
A parameter's value: a number (a length, an angle in radians), a point of the definition's coordinates, a flip
or a name (a visibility state, a lookup row).

ParameterKind.description: What a parameter's value is: a length in the drawing's unit, an angle in the project's angle unit, or a number.

ParcelApproval.description: An approval written outside KentOS, as written (docs/adr/5020): its number (never empty), its date and who approved.

ParcelDocument.description:
A document that made or closed parcels: its name, unique in the drawing; its kind as the user
writes it (a plan, a deed …); the date it gives, as written; a note.

ParcelDraft.description:
A document not yet approved (docs/adr/5020): its fields as a document's, the parcels it would make and the recorded
parcels it would close. Approving it writes it as a document with the next number; nothing current changes before.

ParcelRegister.description:
The register: documents, boundaries and parcels, each numbered 1, 2, 3 … in the order they were made; the lengths
the documents state; the drafts, numbered apart (docs/adr/5020).

ParkedPin.description: The pins of a row outside the part (docs/adr/0578 §3).

key.description: The key's value of the row when the link has a key and the row had a value.

pins.description: The pins, as the object held them.

PathEntity.description: Polyline or polygon: vertices, DXF bulges (tan(θ/4), CCW positive) and, for polygons, holes.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

closed.description:
A polyline whose last vertex joins its first: a closed line, not an
area (docs/adr/0258 §1); its closing edge's bulge is the last of
`bulges`. One part only. A polygon is a ring without saying so.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

parts.description:
A polygon's or a polyline's parts past its first, whose own are the
fields above; absent for one part (docs/adr/0143, 0174). A
polyline's parts are open, of two vertices or more, without holes.

spaceSeparator.description:
Explicit virtual room boundary; absent keeps an ordinary path. Only a
single planar, widthless polyline may carry the architectural role.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

widths.description:
A polyline's widths: the start and the end of the edge from each
vertex, as many as `pts` (the last is the closing edge's, `[0, 0]`
on an open polyline), in the drawing's length, not the paper's line
weight (docs/adr/0258 §2). Absent: none, the line is drawn with its
line weight. One part only.

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

zs.description:
Each vertex's elevation, m, as many as `pts`; `null` for a vertex
without one (not 0); absent when no vertex has one (docs/adr/0142).

PatternElement.description:
An element of a pattern: a dash (a positive length), a gap (negative), a dot (0), or a text or a shape (0: it
takes no length of its own).

PatternLine.description:
One family of a pattern's lines (docs/adr/0186 §1), in the pattern's
units, before the pattern turns: lines at `angle` (degrees) through
`origin`, each the next `offset` on (`[along, across]` the line), drawn
as `dashes` say (plus drawn, minus a gap, 0 a dot; none: whole).

PatternShape.description: A shape of a shape file in a pattern (`[CIRC1,ltypeshp.shx]`).

file.description: The SHX file it is in, as written.

rotation.description: R (along the line), A (absolute) or U (along the line, kept readable): degrees.

scale.description: S: its height (a text) or its scale (a shape), in the pattern's unit.

rotation.description: R (along the line), A (absolute) or U (along the line, kept readable): degrees.

scale.description: S: its height (a text) or its scale (a shape), in the pattern's unit.

style.description: The text style it names, as written.

PatternUnit.description: Where a pattern's lengths are measured.

oneOf.description: Millimetres on paper: the same on every sheet, the drawing's scale over 1000 metres in it (KentOS's own types).
The drawing's own lengths, in the project's unit (a LIN file's).

PavementDef.description: A template's pavement: its layers from the top down and how they end.

PavementEdge.description: How a pavement's layers end at a side's hinge (docs/adr/0975 §1).

oneOf.description: A vertical line at the hinge.
A line from the hinge falling `h` horizontal per one vertical, the layers carried out to it.

PavementLayerDef.description:
A pavement layer: its name (aşınma, binder, temel …), its thickness and an optional material code (a pay item's,
docs/adr/0909).

PayBookDef.description:
The project's pay item book (docs/adr/0909 §4): its source (the agency's list and year, required: KentOS gives no
item), its version, its currency, its items and its rules.

PayItemDef.description: An agency's pay item: its code (as the agency writes it), name, unit (as written) and optional unit price.

PayMeasure.description: A quantity KentOS reads from a road project's structures and earthwork (docs/adr/0909 §4).

oneOf.description: A guardrail's runs, both sides (m).
A culvert's barrel (m).
A culvert's pipes: count × barrel (m).
A culvert's barrel concrete (m³).
A retaining wall's face in plan (m).
A retaining wall's stem face (m²).
A retaining wall's concrete (m³).
An earthwork volume's cut (m³).
An earthwork volume's fill (m³).
An earthwork volume's cut times its swell factors (m³).
An earthwork volume's fill times its shrink factors (m³).

PayRuleDef.description:
A rule giving an item a quantity: KentOS's `measure` (of the culverts or walls of `material` only, when given)
times `factor`.

PenCategory.description: What a pen draws (docs/adr/0783 §1): the objects of a kind; `others` everything no category names.

oneOf.description: Stairs and ramps.
Texts, paragraphs and leaders.
Block inserts: furniture, fixtures, symbols.
Every other object: lines, areas, curves.

PhaseView.description:
Which tadilat durumları the drawing shows and how (docs/adr/0346 §2): Tümü, Mevcut durum, Yıkım planı, Yeni durum;
Tadilat projesi (docs/adr/8039 §5) every state with Mimarlar Odası's three techniques.

oneOf.description: Tadilat projesi (docs/adr/8039 §5): mevcut a plain outline, ilave hatched, iptal dashed, in one plan.

PlanDraft.description:
A plan change draft: its id, the plan (`PlanKimlik`) it changes, the drawing's revision it was made from, its
reason and its changes.

PlanDraftChange.description: A change a draft makes to a decision area: the field and its value before (empty: the area had none) and after.

PlatformDef.description:
A graded pad (docs/adr/0927): its boundary's corners, the plane through `base` rising `grade` (0.02 is 2 %; docs/adr/0977) towards
`direction` (degrees counterclockwise from +x), its cut and fill slopes (horizontal per vertical), the spacing of
its slope lines along an edge, a corner's widest fan step (degrees), the longest slope line and the terrain it is
graded to. The slopes are the user's: no soil's default is guessed (ROAD-GRADE-02).

text.description: What was done, in a sentence.

emailNotifications.description: Notifications also go out by e-mail / SMS (docs/adr/9000 §17).

emailTransport.description: How this server sends them (`sendmail`, `webhook`, `folder`); none: it is not set up to.

PlatformSettingsEdit.description: `PUT /v1/platform/settings`: what changes; a field left out stays as it is.

PlatformTenantDetail.description: An organisation with its members, for its administrators' page.

signup.description: Opened by its owner through signing up, not yet attested by an administrator.

PlatformUserEdit.description: An account's status (`active`, `disabled`) or a new password; either or both.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

srid.description: The files' system; 0: they named none and the user took the project's.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

min.description: The ramp's least and most value (heights in metres, or intensities).

ramp.description: One of the rasters' ramps (`RASTER_RAMPS`); absent: Arazi.

rgb8.description: Colours with 8 significant bits (a file that writes 0–255 in its 16-bit fields).

PointEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

parts.description:
A multi-point object's points past its first, whose own are the
fields above; absent for one point (docs/adr/0174).

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

oneOf.description: Around it, QGIS's cartographic order (top right first).
On it.

PointPart.description:
A point of a multi-point object past its first (docs/adr/0174): its
place and elevation, as the point's own fields hold the first's.

PointRevision.description: An accepted point's revision a use was made from.

PointSizeUnit.description: The unit of a point's size.

oneOf.description: Pixels on the screen (independent of the device's pixels).
Metres on the ground (at least a pixel).

PointVelocity.description:
A point's velocity east, north, up (m/yr) and the velocity grid it was read from, by its name and SHA-256
(docs/adr/4920): the grid's displacement over one year at the point, by the coordinate chain itself.

PortalMembership.description: One organisation the person belongs to, as the portal opens it.

usable.description: Membership active, seat allocated, organisation active: it can be used now.

averageDecisionDays.description: Days from the first sending to the decision, of the ones decided in the period.

decided.description: Applications approved or rejected in the period.

feesAssessed.description: Kuruş assessed in the period (not cancelled), and paid in it.

from.description: The period, both days in it (YYYY-MM-DD, Turkey's calendar).

openNow.description: Applications open now (sent, in review, waiting for corrections).

overdueNow.description: Of those waiting for the municipality, the ones past their legal deadline now.

received.description: Applications sent for the first time in the period.

Profession.description: A professional's profession; their chamber follows from it.

ProfessionalCard.description: A professional in a municipality's directory.

dossiers.description: Dossiers this organisation has with them.

ProfessionalEdit.description: `PUT /v1/portal/me/professional`: what a professional changes in their own profile.

ProfessionalStatus.description: Where an administrator's check of a professional stands.

chamberNo.description: Their chamber registration number, as they gave it.

listed.description: Whether municipalities find them in their directory.

ProfileCrossingDef.description:
Something a road crosses (docs/adr/0946): its name, station on the profile's alignment, side, elevation (underside
or top) and the clearance under it or the cover over it (m). The values are the project's.

ProfileDef.description:
A vertical alignment's definition (docs/adr/0902): the alignment it lies on and that alignment's revision when it
was last made or rebound (a newer one makes it stale), its PVIs, and the surface whose terrain profile it is read
against.

alignmentRevision.description: The alignment's revision it was made or rebound against; absent: 0.

crossings.description: What the road crosses (docs/adr/0946; KCAD schema 172).

id.description: Unique in the project.

name.description: Its name (“Proje kotu”), unique in the project.

revision.description: Grows by one with every change; absent: 0.

surface.description: The terrain surface's id; absent: none.

ProfileFileKind.description: What a project's profile file is: a data profile or a mapping of one.

ProfileForbid.description: What forbids an edge to a profile: the edge field's values (Turkish case aside).

ProfileLimit.description:
A profile's limit: the vehicle's value (tonnes, metres …) against the edge field's: closed where the field reads
a number below it; an empty field, no limit.

ProfilePvi.description:
A PVI of a vertical alignment (docs/adr/0902 §2): its persistent id, its station along the alignment (its own
horizontal length from the start, not its km), its elevation, and the curve on it: a symmetric parabola (`length`),
an asymmetric one (`lengthIn` and `lengthOut` together) or a circle (`radius`); none of them: no curve. The first
and the last carry none.

id.description: Unique in the profile.

length.description: A symmetric parabola's horizontal length; absent or 0: none.

lengthIn.description: An asymmetric parabola's horizontal length before the PVI; absent or 0: none.

radius.description: A circular curve's radius in the station–elevation plane; absent or 0: none.

levels.description: The levels it spans (docs/adr/0784 §1), by their ids, each once; a level may be another building's too.

ProgramUnit.description: A group of spaces: an independent unit, a common area or an outdoor area.

annexOf.description: An annex's independent unit (docs/adr/8031): the id of the group of kind `unit` it is allocated to.

landFactor.description:
An independent unit's value factor in the land shares (docs/adr/8031; Kat Mülkiyeti Kanunu 3: values by
location and size): a decimal as written (“1.15”), read exactly; 1 when absent.

nature.description:
Niteliği (docs/adr/8031; `.kcad` schema 223; Kat Mülkiyeti Kanunu 12/a: "kat, daire, iş bürosu gibi nevi"):
what the deed calls it (“Daire”, “Dükkân”, “İş bürosu”; an annex's “Depo”, “Garaj”).

number.description: Its number, as the project writes it (“D1”, “1”, “Ortak”); one per group.

recordedArea.description:
Its recorded (official) area, m², as the user gave it (a deed's, a permit's): read beside the measured one,
never written by a measurement.

shareWeight.description:
Its weight in the common areas' shares when the program shares them by weight (docs/adr/0784 §2): a decimal
written as given (“120”, “1.5”), at most 12 digits before the point and 6 after; read exactly, never as a float.

levels.description:
The levels it spans (docs/adr/0784 §1), by their ids, each once; within its building's when the building names
any. None: not said.

ProjectAccessHolder.description:
One person with a role or a grant in a project, as the share dialog shows
them: the role they work with now and where it comes from.

blocked.description: Why they cannot use it now (when `role` is absent).

expired.description: The grant's end has passed: it no longer counts.

expiresAt.description: RFC 3339, when the grant ends by itself.

grant.description:
Their grant, also an ended one: what sharing gives, changes and takes
away (ownership and the policy are not grants).

guest.description:
Their grant is a guest's (docs/adr/0035): they are outside the
project's organisation and reach it through an accepted invitation.

role.description:
The role they work with now: the highest of ownership, the
organisation's policy and an unexpired grant, the same the server
works out when they open it. Absent when none lets them in now.

ProjectAccessList.description:
`GET …/projects/{project}/access`: who may use the project and why
(needs `project.share`). `people` holds the owner, the organisation's
owners and admins its policy lets in, and every grant (ended ones
included), the owner first, then by name.

adminsAccessAllProjects.description:
The organisation's owners and admins work in its projects not shared
with them (docs/adr/0015); always false in a personal space.

ProjectAccessView.description:
The caller's access to a project: the highest of ownership, a grant and the
organisation's policy, and exactly what it allows. Buttons follow it; the
server checks every request itself.

ProjectCreate.description: `POST /v1/tenants/{tenant}/projects`: a new project's metadata (its objects follow as commands).

arrays.description: The project's associative arrays (docs/adr/0300); absent: none.

casework.description: The project's kitchen runs (docs/adr/0727 §5); absent: none.

constraints.description: The project's constraints and parameters (docs/adr/0336 §3); absent: none.

dimensionSets.description: Persistent architectural dimension recipes; older responses without this field have none.

sheets.description: The project's sheet book and its pictures (docs/adr/0251); absent: none.

storage.description:
How the project is kept, for good (docs/adr/0031); absent: object by
object in PostGIS (`database`). A `file` project gets its content
from its first committed revision.

ProjectDetails.description:
`GET …/projects/{project}/details`: one project's catalog entry with what
is worked out on asking (for the details of a selected project).

bounds.description:
The extent of its objects' stored GIS geometry in the project's
coordinate system (within a millimetre of curved CAD objects, whose
geometry is their projection); absent when it has none. A catalog
hint, not a measurement.

layerCount.description: Leaf layers of its layer tree.

comments.description: The reviewers' comments on the form, oldest first (docs/adr/0441 §5).

enforce.description:
The latest release's rules hold for every attribute write on the layer (the write profile);
written only as `true`, and only with a release.

id.description: Stable, unique in the project: letters, digits, `-`, `_` and `.`; 1–64 characters.

layer.description: The layer the form edits: a layer's id (not a group's).

name.description: What the lists show; trimmed, 1–64 characters.

releases.description: The frozen releases, oldest first; data entry uses the last.

withdrawn.description:
Yayından kaldırıldı (docs/adr/0445 §1): no record is written through it; a window open on it keeps
what was typed. Written only as `true`, and only with a release.

ProjectInfo.description: `GET /v1/tenants/{tenant}/projects/{project}`: what opening needs before the objects.

access.description: What the caller may do in it.

arrays.description: A database project's associative arrays (docs/adr/0300); an older server's answer without them has none.

blocks.description:
A database project's block definitions with their versions
(docs/adr/0144 §5), in the order they were made. An older server's
answer without them has none.

casework.description: A database project's kitchen runs (docs/adr/0727 §5); an older server's answer without them has none.

constraints.description:
A database project's constraints and parameters (docs/adr/0336 §3); an older server's answer without them has
none.

dimensionSets.description: Persistent architectural dimension recipes; older responses without this field have none.

eventCursor.description: Event cursor at the moment this was read: subscribe after it to miss nothing.

sheets.description:
A database project's sheet book and its pictures (docs/adr/0251); an
older server's answer without it has none.

state.description: Active or archived (an archived project opens read-only; one in the trash does not open).

storage.description:
How it keeps its content: a file project opens from its newest
revision (`GET …/files`), not from `…/features` (docs/adr/0031). An
older server's answer without it is a database project.

acceptedByName.description: Who accepted it, when it was accepted.

ProjectInvitations.description:
`GET …/invitations`: a project's invitations, newest first (waiting ones
and those of the last 30 days).

ProjectList.description:
A tenant's projects the caller may see (`GET /v1/tenants/{tenant}/projects`), or
the caller's own and shared ones across tenants (`GET /v1/me/projects`); newest first.

ProjectPage.description: One page of a catalog list.

next.description: The cursor of the next page (`after`); absent on the last page. Opaque.

total.description: How many projects the whole list holds with this search, counted after the access check.

trashRetentionDays.description: How long a project moved to the trash now stays restorable, in days.

ProjectPermission.description:
A permission in a project. The names are fixed: commands (`permissions`
in the catalog), the web, the desktop, Python and AI use them as they are.

oneOf.description: See it in lists, open it, read its objects and events.
Change its objects.
Its name, settings, layer tree and styles.
Delete it (softly: the operator can restore it).
Comments and review notes.
Download and export its files and revisions (viewing is not DRM: what is seen can be copied).
See and open earlier revisions.
Give and take away roles in it.
Hand its ownership over.
Start server jobs on it.
Design the project's forms and relations (docs/adr/0411 §1).
Publish a form's new version.
Edit records through a published form.

ProjectProfileFile.description: A profile or a mapping the project carries inside its file.

name.description: The profile's or the mapping's name, the name of its folder file too: small letters, digits and `-`, at most 64.

text.description: The document, JSON as the folder's file holds it (`kentos.data-profile` or `kentos.profile-mapping`).

ProjectRelation.description:
A relation of the project (docs/adr/0405 §1): the child layer's field holds the parent object's
persistent id.

field.description: The child field's key that holds the parent's persistent id.

id.description: Letters, digits, `-`, `_`, `.`; 1–64; unique in the project.

ProjectRole.description: A role in one project. Each has the rights of the ones before it.

oneOf.description: Veri girişi (docs/adr/0411 §2): edits existing records' attributes through a published form only.
The project's owner; not given by sharing (ownership is transferred).

ProjectSettings.description: Project settings (`ProjectSettingsData`): saved with the drawing, the same for everyone who opens it.

addressLocators.description: The project's address data (docs/adr/0229 §2), in the order they were made.

annotation.description:
The project's annotation heights on paper (docs/adr/0205 §1); absent:
every kind's default.

approvedSheetTemplates.description:
The sheet template revisions the bound office standards approved, as `cad.standards.install` recorded them
(docs/adr/1100 §3): which revision new sheets are made from; existing sheets keep their own origin.

arch.description: The project's levels and the detail its walls are drawn at (docs/adr/0339 §3); absent: no level, by the scale.

autoSelect.description:
Otomatik seçim (docs/adr/0622 §5): on, a click and a box select any shown layer's objects (with the list of
the ones under the click); off, only the active layer's, as a GIS edits one layer at a time. Absent: off in a
CBS project, on otherwise ([`ProjectSettings::auto_select`]).

cadWork.description:
What a CAD project is drawn for (docs/adr/0801): its KentOS program and its ribbon. Only a CAD project has
one; none while it is not asked (CAD projects written before works).

connections.description: The project's service connections without their secrets (docs/adr/0208 §2).

coordinateEpoch.description:
The coordinates' epoch (decimal year, docs/adr/0519 §1): when a dynamic system's coordinates hold; absent: not
said. Only a project with a coordinate system has one.

customCrs.description:
The project's own coordinate system when it is a definition
(docs/adr/0168 §1); `srid` is then 0.

heights.description:

mapSurvey.description:
A map project's GNSS campaign archive (plan/map-cad.md MAP-03, docs/adr/1340): campaigns, sessions, solutions,
accepted points and what was made from them; absent: none. Only a CAD project drawn for a map has it (`.kcad`
schema 194).

mapWork.description:
A map project's work structure (plan/map-cad.md MAP-01, docs/adr/1200): its items and what the objects were
derived from; absent: none. Only a CAD project drawn for a map has it (`.kcad` schema 188).

monitoringReviews.description:
The reviews the project keeps of its monitoring jobs (plan/map-cad.md MAP-19, docs/adr/5220); absent: none
(`.kcad` schema 253).

namedUcs.description: The project's named UCSs, in the order they were kept.

namedViews.description: The project's named views, in the order they were kept (docs/adr/0285 §1).

profileFiles.description:
The data profiles and mappings the project carries inside its file (docs/adr/0735): by name, a profile before a
mapping of the same name; each its JSON document as text. The `profiller` folder beside the drawing's file holds
others; of a name both have, the drawing's is the one read.

reviewNotes.description:
Review notes bound to objects, a sheet or a view, kept apart from the design (docs/adr/1000 §2): never drawn,
plotted or measured. Numbered; their stamps say which state of an object each was written for.

road.description:
A road project's own settings (plan/road.md Y2.2): its terrain surfaces' definitions; absent: none. Only a CAD

nothing else of a road (`.kcad` schema 195, docs/adr/1520).

secondCustomCrs.description: The second system when it is a definition (instead of `second_srid`).

secondSrid.description:
The project's second coordinate system (docs/adr/0167 §1): its
coordinates are shown beside the project's own; absent: none. Never
the project's own system, never a local project's.

sourceBases.description:
The bound layers' bases (docs/adr/0538 §1): each object's hashes when a layer and its table last matched, so a
reconcile tells each side's changes apart. A link has at most one; a layer of more than `MAX_BASE_ROWS`
objects has none.

sources.description: The layers bound to a table of a file, each with the file's revision when it last matched (docs/adr/0503).

standardDocs.description:
Ordered portable drawing standards retained with the project. Earlier
entries take precedence; choosing a standard does not apply it.

standardExceptions.description:
The standards findings the project accepts, each with its reason (docs/adr/1129; `.kcad` schema 190): bound to
the finding, the standard's source and revision and what the drawing had; a change of either lapses it.

survey.description:
The project's survey constants and tolerances (docs/adr/0169 §3);
absent: k = [`REFRACTION`] and no tolerance.

surveyAdjustments.description: The adjustments the project keeps (plan/map-cad.md MAP-18, docs/adr/5200); absent: none (`.kcad` schema 252).

tableStyles.description: The project's named table styles (docs/adr/1126 §2; `.kcad` schema 185), in the order they were made.

textStyles.description: The project's named text styles (docs/adr/0183 §2), in the order they were made.

toolLayers.description: The layer each annotation tool draws on (usage review UR-003); absent: the active layer (`.kcad` schema 255).

topology.description: The project's topology rules, tolerance and exceptions (docs/adr/0202 §1).

ucs.description:
The drawing's user coordinate system (docs/adr/0261 §1); none: the
world. How points are typed and shown, never where they are.

variables.description: The project's own `@` variables (docs/adr/0214 §2.3), in the settings window's order.

viewTemplates.description: The project's view templates, in the order they were kept (docs/adr/0783 §2).

wallStyles.description: The project's named wall styles (docs/adr/0339 §2), in the order they were made.

workspace.description:
The project's type; none while it is not asked (files written before
types). The former Hibrit mode reads as written and means the same
(see [`ProjectSettings::project_type`]).

xrefPaths.description:
The folders external references' sources are looked for in, in order (docs/adr/0349 §1): absolute, or relative
to the project file's folder with `/` between their parts.

zoningPlan.description:
A zoning plan's kept symbol choices and plan change drafts (plan/map-cad.md MAP-09, docs/adr/5040); absent: none
(`.kcad` schema 250).

ProjectSheets.description: The sheet book of a project and its pictures' bytes.

book.description: The sheet core's book (`kentos.sheet/1`): an object, opaque here.

pictures.description: The bytes of the book's pictures; none when it has none.

ProjectStandardDocument.description: An exact versioned standard document retained in the drawing file.

text.description:
UTF-8 JSON document, with its format, document version, identity and
office revision. Keeping the complete text allows exact re-export.

ProjectState.description: Where a project is in its life. Removed for good, it is gone: every request answers 404.

oneOf.description: Read-only: it opens, but its content and catalog metadata do not change until it is unarchived.
Soft-deleted (410 to opening and writing); restorable until the retention removes it for good.

File projects (binary `.kcad` revisions) and references to an outside

the server's object store (docs/adr/0031); each save is a new
revision, based on the one it replaces.

areaUnit.description: The unit its areas are given in (lengths and coordinates are metres of its coordinate system).

catalogVersion.description:

sends it as `expectedVersions["@catalog"]`. Decimal text.

creatorName.description: Who created it; empty when the caller cannot see them.

openedAt.description: When the caller last opened it (RFC 3339).

ownerName.description:

when the caller cannot see the owner (one who left the organisation).

projectType.description: What kind of work it is: a label, not a claim of compliance, independent of `storage`.

purgeAfter.description:

trashedAt.description: When it was moved to the trash (RFC 3339).

trashedByName.description: Who moved it there, when the caller can see them.

closed.description: Its line runs on from its last point back to its first: round a gallery's void.

gap.description: The clear gap between its balusters, metres; absent: 0.10 (PAİY 38/4's most). Read with balusters alone.

linePattern.description:

A boundary: from one corner to another (`from` the lesser by east, then north), its bulge from `from` to `to` (0:

ReviewedThresholds.description: The two thresholds as kept, with their source: who set them, by which document or decision, when.

ReviewerRole.description:
Who reviewed, as the regulations name them (Genelge 2025/4 m. 3, m. 12(16)–(20); BÖHHBÜY m. 76): the engineer
responsible for the job, the control engineer, the technical staff with the control, the one who approves.

RinexFacts.description:
What a RINEX observation file's header said that is kept nowhere else: its version (as written), the marker's
number, the interval (s) and the approximate position (ECEF XYZ, m).

RingGeometry.description: A closed ring in vertex + bulge form (a polygon hole).

zs.description:
Each vertex's elevation, m, as many as `pts`; `null` for a vertex
without one (not 0); absent when no vertex has one (docs/adr/0142).

RoadDrawingDef.description:
A drawing a road command made (docs/adr/0911 §1): its id, the command and its input as given, the sources it was
made from (its main source first), the objects it wrote in order and the stamp of those objects as written; since
schema 209 (docs/adr/2840) the command's version that drew it and the drawing's revision its write made.

digest.description: 16 lower-case hex digits: the objects' JSON in order, stamped.

revision.description:
The drawing's revision once its objects were written, as the commands say it (decimal digits; docs/adr/2840);
none: a record written before schema 209.

version.description: The version of the command that drew it (docs/adr/2840); none: a record written before schema 209.

RoadDrawingSource.description: A source a drawing was made from: its kind, id and the stamp of what it was (docs/adr/0911 §1).

digest.description: 16 lower-case hex digits: its definition's canonical JSON stamped (a surface's with its sources' digest).

RoadSettings.description: A road project's settings; absent while it has none.

alignments.description: The horizontal alignments (docs/adr/0901), in the order the project tree shows them.

autoRebuild.description: A write that leaves drawings stale draws them again in its step (docs/adr/0911 §3); off unless chosen.

corridors.description: The corridors (docs/adr/0905), each on an alignment, in the order the project tree shows them.

culverts.description: The culverts (docs/adr/0909 §2), each across a corridor.

drawings.description: What the road commands drew (docs/adr/0911 §1): each drawing's command, input, sources and objects.

guardrails.description: The guardrails (docs/adr/0909 §1), each along a corridor.

junctions.description: The junctions (docs/adr/0910 §2), each of two alignments.

pay.description: The pay item book (docs/adr/0909 §4): the agency's items and the rules that give them KentOS's quantities.

platforms.description: The graded pads (docs/adr/0927), each on a terrain surface.

profiles.description: The vertical alignments (docs/adr/0902), each on an alignment, in the order the project tree shows them.

rebuildWhole.description:
Drawing again, by hand from the project tree or by itself, draws each drawing whole (docs/adr/4740); unless
chosen, only what changed is written (docs/adr/4320). Since `.kcad` schema 238.

sections.description: The sample line sets (docs/adr/0903 §2), in the order the project tree shows them.

sheetSets.description: The plan–profile sheet sets (docs/adr/0908 §10), each along an alignment.

superelevations.description: The superelevation schedules (docs/adr/0904), each on an alignment, in the order the project tree shows them.

surfaces.description: The terrain surfaces, in the order the project tree shows them.

templates.description: The templates (docs/adr/0903 §3), in the order the project tree shows them.

volumes.description: The earthwork volumes (docs/adr/0906), each of a corridor, in the order the project tree shows them.

walls.description: The retaining walls (docs/adr/0909 §3), each along a corridor's side.

RoadSheetDef.description:
A sheet of a plan–profile set: the book's sheet, the stations it shows (internal, m) and the profile view drawn for
it (its frame's lower left and upper right), when the set has a profile.

RoadSheetSetDef.description:
A plan–profile sheet set (docs/adr/0908 §10; Civil 3D's view frame group): sheets along an alignment, each showing
its stretch in plan at the set's scale (1:`scale`) and, with a profile, the profile view drawn for it; the sources'
revisions it was made from, so the sheets say when the alignment or the profile changed since.

sections.description: A section sheet set's sample line set (docs/adr/0908 §11) and its revision.

RoadSource.description:
A source a road answer was computed from, as it is now (docs/adr/1038, 1039, 1040): its id and revision (0 where
the project has no such source).

RoadSourceKind.description: What kind of road source a drawing depends on (docs/adr/0911 §1).

oneOf.description: A utility network (docs/adr/3560): its definition and the objects of its layers.

A layer of the drawing (docs/adr/4740): the geometries of its objects in the drawing's order. A sheet's
contour lines read their details, slopes, chosen points, built-up areas and roads from layers.

RoadSurfaceSource.description:
The terrain surface a road answer was computed on (docs/adr/1038, 1039, 1040): its id, the digest of what it is
made of now (the drawing's points and lines it was triangulated from, with its method; absent where the project
has no such surface) and the digest it was last accepted from (absent: never accepted). The two differ when the
drawing changed after the surface was accepted: the answer is the drawing's of now.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

gutter.description: Its gutter (oluk, docs/adr/8044 §8): its width outside every sloping eaves edge, metres; absent: none.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

offset.description: Its eaves' height over its storey's top (the next storey's floor), else over ±0.00, metres; absent: 0.

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

overhang.description: How far its eaves were drawn past the walls' outer faces (saçak), metres.

parts.description: Its chimneys, vents and roof windows (docs/adr/8044 §6).

pts.description: Its eaves line, closed: at least three points, either way round.

slopes.description:
Each edge's slope from its eaves, per cent (rise ÷ run × 100), the edge from `pts[i]` to the next point (the last
back to the first); none: a gable end (kalkan). As many as the points.

snowGuard.description:
Its snow guard (kar siperliği, docs/adr/8044 §8): its distance in from every sloping eaves edge, metres; absent:
none.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

thickness.description: Its build-up's thickness (kaplama, çıta, tahta, mertek), metres, measured upright; absent: 0.25.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

RoofPart.description: A part of a roof (docs/adr/8044 §6): a chimney, a vent or a roof window.

depth.description:
Its depth, metres: a window's down its face's slope, in the roof's plane (Sivas's 1.50 m is measured so); a
chimney's or a vent's across its width.

rise.description:
A chimney's top over the roof's ridge, a vent's over the roof at its highest corner, metres; absent: 0.80, 0.60.
A window has none.

rotation.description: A chimney's or a vent's turn in plan, radians counter-clockwise; absent: 0. A window takes its face's.

width.description: Its width, metres: a window's along its face's eaves (across the slope), a chimney's or a vent's along its turn.

oneOf.description: Duman bacası: its top 0.80 m over the ridge unless given.
Hava bacası: its top 0.60 m over the roof at its place unless given.
Çatı penceresi: in its face's plane, turned with its face's slope.
İniş borusu (docs/adr/8044 §8): under the gutter, outside the eaves, its width its diameter.

ScanState.description: How far a kept file was checked.

oneOf.description: An antivirus daemon scanned it and found nothing; the type rules passed it too.
Only the type rules passed it: the server has no antivirus daemon, or the daemon could not scan it then.

ScenarioInfo.description:
A group made a scenario (docs/adr/0210 §9): its layers are an alternative
kept apart from the field state (Mevcut durum).

ScheduleField.description: What one column of a schedule reads.

oneOf.description: An opening's type's joinery code (docs/adr/8028; KCAD schema 220): grouped by it, the joinery list.
The attribute the column's `attr` names.
A space's finishes (docs/adr/0733 §3): its floor's, its base's (the skirting's), its walls' and its ceiling's.
A space's baseboard: its perimeter less the passages along it (docs/adr/0722 §5).
A fixture's block's category path (docs/adr/0317 §4).
The space a fixture stands in, on its level: its number and name.

An opening's widths (docs/adr/0772 §2): the rough opening (its `width`, under its own name), the frame's outer
width, the leaf width and the net clear width.
A space's group in the building program: its number and name (docs/adr/0773).
A space's design target: its brief's area range.
How far a space's area lies outside its brief's range (below minus, above plus).

An opening's operation (Kanatlı, Sürme, Döner, Cebe giren, Katlanır …), its leaves (a revolving door's wings, a
folding door's panels), a revolving door's drum and a pocket door's pockets' length (docs/adr/0777 §5).
A space's unit's share of the common areas (docs/adr/0784 §3): the unit's, alike on each of its spaces.
A space's unit's gross area: its own rooms and its share.

A three- or four-leaf sliding door's or window's tracks and its leaves' layout, fixed O and sliding X from its
start (docs/adr/0792 §1).

A unit's kind (Bağımsız bölüm, Ortak alan, Dış alan), its building's and its wing's names, its recorded area and
its share weight (docs/adr/0795): a units schedule's.

Planlı Alanlar İmar Yönetmeliği 4's areas of a units schedule's group (docs/adr/8029; `.kcad` schema 221): its
net area, its gross (outer contour: the façade's outer face, a shared wall's axis), its part of the common
areas' gross and its general gross (gross and part).

Kat irtifakı (docs/adr/8031; `.kcad` schema 223): a units schedule's group's nature (Kat Mülkiyeti Kanunu 12/a:
daire, dükkân, iş bürosu …), its annexes' net and gross areas, its annexes said (their nature or name and gross),
its total gross (PAİY 4/ğ-4: its gross and its annexes') and its land share (“225/450”).

Mahal listesi (docs/adr/8038; `.kcad` schema 228; Planlı Alanlar İmar Yönetmeliği 57(29)): a space's window
sills' and parapets', its stair's treads' and risers', and its handrails' and railings' finishes; the doors and the
windows that serve it, by their joinery codes (“K01, P01 (2)”).

ScheduleFilter.description: Which objects a schedule lists: those of every list given.

buildings.description: A units schedule's groups' buildings, wings and kinds (docs/adr/0795): the buildings' and wings' ids.

levels.description: Their levels' ids (an opening's its wall's).

types.description:
Their types (docs/adr/0733 §4): an opening's type, a wall's style, a column's kind, a space's usage, a fixture's
block name.

oneOf.description: The drawing's block inserts: furniture, sanitary fixtures, kitchen modules (docs/adr/0733 §2).
The building program's groups (docs/adr/0795): independent units, common and outdoor areas, a row each.

ScheduleSort.description: A sort key: a column by its index, in order or reversed.

footer.description: A subtotal row after each such group: “‹value› toplamı” and the summed columns' sums.

header.description: A heading row before each group of rows alike in this column: its value, across the row (docs/adr/0733 §4).

SectionSetDef.description:
A sample line set (docs/adr/0903 §1–§2): on an alignment of its own PIs (its revision held), with an optional profile
on it, template and surface; its swath widths and how its stations are had.

clip.description:
Lines that meet on a curve's inside are shortened to their meeting, nearest first (docs/adr/0933 §1; schema
166); otherwise they are left and said.

superelevation.description: The superelevation schedule on the same alignment its lanes take their cross slopes from (docs/adr/0904 §3).

SectionStations.description: How a sample line set's stations are had (docs/adr/0903 §2).

oneOf.description:
Every round `every` metres of km from `from` to `to` (the alignment's own stations) and both of them, with the
curves' points and the profile's PVIs when `geometry`.

curve.description: On curves and clothoids every round `curve` metres too (docs/adr/0933 §3; schema 168).

oneOf.description:
Where the centreline's ground breaks (it crosses a triangle's edge of the set's surface) from `from` to `to`,
kept so the ground read linearly between two sections is within `tolerance` metres of the exact profile, with
no gap longer than `most` metres where the profile has a break to fill it, and with the curves' points and the
profile's PVIs when `geometry` (docs/adr/0933 §3; schema 168).
The stations written.
Where lines and polylines of the drawing (their persistent ids) first cross the alignment.

ServerJob.description: A job as its project's users see it.

baseRevision.description: The project's data revision when the job was asked for, as text.

cachedFrom.description:
The earlier job whose artifact this one took: the project's state, the input, the reach and the server's software
were the same (docs/adr/0739 §2).

progressText.description: What the worker says it is doing, a few Turkish words, while the job runs (docs/adr/0559 §3).

ServerJobArtifact.description: A succeeded job's artifact in the object store.

name.description: The file name a download gives it.

ServerJobCreate.description:
What a user asks for (`POST …/projects/{project}/jobs`). A request with a request id the same user sent before for
the project gets that job, whatever this one says.

fresh.description:
Built again whatever was built before (docs/adr/0739 §2): an export, an atlas or a file-writing tool otherwise
takes the artifact of an earlier job built from the same project state, input, reach and software.

requestId.description: 1–200 characters: the client's own id of this request.

code.description:
`timeout`, `lease_lost`, `forbidden`, `revision_conflict`, `gone`, `invalid`, `storage` (the artifact could
not be written: no folder, no right), `storage_full` (the object store had no room left for it; nothing of it
is kept, docs/adr/0739 §3), `too_large` (the artifact is past the server's limit) or `failed`; a
`project.processing` job also `cpu_limit`, `memory_limit` (stopped at its budget), `memory_estimate` (refused
before it ran), `tool_failed`, `tool_unavailable`, `unsupported_change`, `too_many_changes` and `crashed`
(docs/adr/0559); a `project.import` or `project.atlas` job also the refusal code of the command the worker ran
(`import_unreadable`, `crs_mismatch`, `nothing_to_import`, `pin_mismatch`, `atlas_empty` …, docs/adr/0561).

ServerJobList.description: A project's jobs, newest first, at most [`SERVER_JOB_LIST_MAX`].

ServiceConnection.description:
A connection of the project (docs/adr/0208 §2): what proof requests to
its origin carry, without the secrets.

origin.description: `https://host[:port]`: proof goes to this origin only.

oneOf.description: Tiles by an address template, Web Mercator (TMS with `yFlip`).
OGC API Tiles' map tiles.
An ArcGIS REST MapServer or ImageServer: its cached tiles, else `export`.
Google's Map Tiles API, 2D tiles.
Vector tiles (MVT) by a MapLibre style, a TileJSON or a template.

ServiceLayer.description: A layer drawn from a service (docs/adr/0208 §2).

bbox.description:
The service's extent, WGS 84 degrees (west, south, east, north), as
its capabilities give it: what “Servisin kapsamına yakınlaştır” shows.

connection.description: The project's connection whose proof goes with the requests.

dynamic.description: WMS and `export`: one picture of the view instead of tiles.

grid.description: WMTS's, OGC's and a cached ArcGIS service's matrices.

layers.description: WMS's layer names; WMTS's one layer; ArcGIS's layers shown.

preset.description: The ready basemap it came from.

srid.description: The system asked: WMS's `CRS`, ArcGIS's `imageSR`; a grid's own.

style.description: WMS's and WMTS's style; Google's map type.

template.description: WMTS REST's and OGC's tile template.

tileSize.description: XYZ's and the vector tiles' tile side, pixels; absent 256.

url.description:
XYZ: the template; WMS, WMTS, ArcGIS: the service's address; OGC
API Tiles: the tile set's; vector: the style's, the TileJSON's or the
template; Google: empty.

yFlip.description: TMS: rows counted from the bottom.

ServiceParam.description: A parameter sent with every request (`TIME`, `CQL_FILTER`, …): never a secret.

SessionView.description: One of the account's sessions: a browser's (cookie) or a program's (bearer).

current.description: The session this request came with.

ShareCandidate.description: A person the project can be shared with.

ShareCandidates.description:
`GET …/projects/{project}/access/candidates?q=`: people whose name or
e-mail holds every word of `q` (Turkish letters folded), among those the
caller may see and share with (needs `project.share`): an organisation
project's active members, or, for a personal space's project, the active
members of the caller's own organisations. The caller and the owner are
left out; at most 20, by name.

ShareRule.description: How the common areas are shared out.

oneOf.description: The same for each unit of the scope.
By each unit's own rooms' area.
By each unit's `shareWeight`.

SheetPicture.description: A picture's bytes under the SHA-256 the book names it by.

bytes.description: The file's bytes; base64 (RFC 4648, with padding) in JSON.

oneOf.description: An API client with an OpenID access token (no browser session).
A program with one of the account's personal access tokens (docs/adr/9000 §12).

SignatureKind.description: How the reviewer signed, as stated: by hand on the paper, or with a secure electronic signature (5070 m. 5).

oneOf.description: A browser, through KentOS İmza on the computer.
The KentOS desktop, in its own process.

SigningFile.description: A file as the request names it: the digest is of the bytes the server keeps.

SigningLegalCheck.description:
How far a signature's legal validity was checked: the key signed these bytes is proved; the certificate's chain to
the authority's roots and its revocation are not checked yet (`not_done`). More values will come.

oneOf.description: Every file signed and verified.
Some were.

SigningRequestCreate.description: `POST /v1/dossiers/{id}/signing`: the files of the dossier to sign.

SigningRequestCreated.description: The request issued: its envelope goes to the signing service as it is.

expiresAt.description: RFC 3339, UTC: after this the service refuses it.

signedRequest.description: The compact JWS (`EdDSA`, `KSI-SR`) the signing service checks against `GET /v1/signing/trust`.

SigningSigner.description: The signer as the server read the certificate (not as the client said).

fingerprintSha256.description: SHA-256 of the certificate, upper-case hex.

SigningTrust.description: `GET /v1/signing/trust`: the key the signing service checks the server's requests with.

publicKey.description: The server's Ed25519 public key: standard base64 of its 32 bytes.

SigningVerdict.description: `POST /v1/signing/{transactionId}/result`: the server's check of what the client delivered.

reason.description: Why it was refused, in Turkish.

Signup.description: `POST /v1/portal/signup`, and an administrator opening a professional's account.

ticket.description: `GET /v1/portal/signup`'s ticket (signing up by oneself; an administrator opening the account needs none).

website.description: A field the form's people do not see: filled, the request is a machine's (docs/adr/9000 §20).

SignupInfo.description: `GET /v1/portal/signup`: whether the platform takes sign-ups now.

ticket.description:
The form's ticket while sign-ups are open: brought back with the sign-up, no sooner than a few seconds and no
later than two hours, once (docs/adr/9000 §20).

SiteEdge.description: A parcel edge (docs/adr/8032): its kind and the plan's own setback where the plan gives one, m.

SiteEdgeKind.description: A parcel edge's kind (docs/adr/8032; Planlı Alanlar İmar Yönetmeliği 23/1): what its garden distance is measured by.

oneOf.description: Yan bahçe: at least 3.00 m, half a metre more for each storey past four (23/1-b, ç).
Ön bahçe, a road's edge: at least 5.00 m (23/1-a).
Arka bahçe: at least 3.00 m, half a metre more for each storey past four (23/1-c, ç).
A public area's edge (a park, a square): at least 5.00 m, no storey's increase (23/1-a, ç).

SitePlan.description:
Vaziyet planı (docs/adr/8032; Planlı Alanlar İmar Yönetmeliği 23, 57/2-a): the parcel drawn as a closed line or a
polygon (its persistent id), each edge's kind and setback in the boundary's order (edge i from corner i to i + 1;
past the list a side garden), ±0.00's absolute elevation (the röper's) and the setback line the document keeps on
the parcel and the storeys.

envelope.description: Yapı yaklaşma sınırı: the persistent id of the closed line the document keeps on the setbacks.

SlabBound.description:
A slab whose outline follows its source (Kaynağa bağlı sınır, docs/adr/0771 §4): what it comes from, the seed and
the face rule (walls) or the space's persistent id, the edge offset, and, the document's, the walls that bound it
when it was last found and why it is broken. Absent on a slab: its outline is its own (Bağımsız kontur).

offset.description: Every edge moved by this much, out when positive; at most 10 m either way. Absent: 0.

seed.description: The point the walls are read round (walls).

space.description: The space, by its persistent id (space).

uids.description: The walls whose faces bound it when it was last found, by their persistent ids (the document's).

SlabBreak.description: Why a bound slab's outline is not what its source says: the last one kept as it was.

oneOf.description: The walls no longer close round its seed (or the outline moved by its offset turns over).
Its space is gone (deleted, or no longer a space).

SlabEdge.description:
The edge a slab carries along its free sides: its kind, its width inward from the outline and the runs it is drawn
along (the document's: every edge of the outline whose middle no wall's face on the slab's level runs through).

SlabEdgeKind.description: What runs along a slab's free sides.

oneOf.description: Korkuluk: two thin lines `width` apart.
Parapet: a filled band `width` wide.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.
