attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

bound.description:
Kaynağa bağlı sınır (docs/adr/0771 §4): its outline found again from its source whenever that changes; absent:
an outline of its own.

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

excluded.description: Left out of the quantities' totals: listed, not summed.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

layers.description:
Its layers besides its structure (docs/adr/8040 §2): kaplama, şap, yalıtım over it, sıva under it; absent: the
structure alone, its top the finished floor.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

material.description: What it is made of (Betonarme); absent: not said.

materialId.description:
The project material it binds to (docs/adr/0785), by its id: its `material` is the material's name and follows
it. Absent: its own text material.

offset.description: Its top above its level's elevation, metres (negative: below it); at most 100 either way. Absent: 0.

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

parts.description: Its outline: one part or more, each an outer ring and its holes (a courtyard, a hole for a lowered wet room).

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

SlabFace.description: Which of the walls' faces a bound slab runs along (the command's `SlabBoundary`, kept with the slab).

oneOf.description: Dış yüzler.
Oda: the room's inner faces.

SlabLayer.description: A layer of a slab besides its structure (docs/adr/8040 §2).

material.description: What it is made of (Seramik, Laminat parke …); absent: not said.

SlabLayerKind.description:
What a layer of a slab besides its structure is (docs/adr/8040 §2): TS 825's floor build-up (a storey's floor: its
finish, screed, insulation; a terrace's waterproofing too) and the ceiling's plaster under it. The finish is PAİY
4(1)(ıı)'s "taban döşeme kaplaması", the plaster its "tavan kaplaması".

oneOf.description: Kaplama.
Şap.
Isı yalıtımı.
Su yalıtımı.
Sıva.

SlabLayers.description:
A slab's layers besides its structure (its `thickness`, docs/adr/8040 §2), each list from the top: those over the
structure (kaplama, şap, yalıtım) and those under it (sıva). Its top (its level's elevation and offset) is the top of
the first over the structure: the finished floor the storey's height is measured from (PAİY 4(1)(rr)).

oneOf.description: Döşeme: a storey's floor.
Balkon.
Teras.

SlabRun.description: A run of a slab's free sides: an open polyline along its outline, one bulge per edge when an edge is an arc.

SlabSourceKind.description:
What a bound slab's outline comes from (docs/adr/0771 §4): the walls round a point (their outer faces, a storey's
floor; or a room's inner faces), or a space's rings (a floor finish, a wet room's slab).

oneOf.description: Duvarlar: the walls round the seed.
Mahal: the space's rings.
The receiver's own real-time solution, from its log.
A baseline, PPK or static solution processed in office software.
A precise point positioning service's.

SourceBase.description:
A bound layer's base (docs/adr/0538 §1): each object's hashes when the layer and its table last matched, so a
later reconcile tells what the layer changed from what the table did, object by object. The layer's hash is that of
the object's kind, geometry and attributes (the first 8 bytes of the SHA-256 of their canonical JSON, the
essence `layer_digest` hashes); the table's that of the object its row reads as. The two differ only where a row
does not read back bit for bit as the object written (a coordinate system moved through). A base belongs to the
link's `revision` and `digest` it was taken at: with others it is stale and not used.

fields.description:
What each row's object held besides its hashes (docs/adr/0553 §1), one record per row in the same order, in
base64: the hashes of its kind and geometry on each side, of each attribute (name and value) and of its
vertices. Without it two sides' changes to one object cannot be told apart field by field (a conflict as a
whole, docs/adr/0538), nor related changes found. Written only when it fits [`MAX_FIELD_BASE_BYTES`].

revision.description: The file's SHA-256 and the layer's digest it was taken at.

rows.description: The rows, `BASE_ROW` bytes each in the lasting ids' byte order, in base64 (RFC 4648, with padding).

oneOf.description: A PostGIS table (docs/adr/0505): `path` is the database's address without a password.

SourceLink.description: A layer bound to a table of a file.

checks.description:
The table's CHECK constraints as the link last read them (docs/adr/0755 §1): every write of a record is asked them
with SQL's own meaning, and one that ties a column to a list of values makes the field's value list. Binding and
every reading of the table write them anew.

digest.description:
The layer's digest when it last matched the file (64 hex digits: the SHA-256 of its objects' kinds, geometries
and attributes by lasting id, `kentos_native_application::sources::layer_digest`): a reload compares with it to
tell the layer's own edits from the file's.

extent.description:
The area the working copy holds (minimum east, north, maximum east, north, in the project's system; docs/adr/0510):
only the table's rows whose box meets it are read, and a write leaves the rows outside as they are. None: the
whole table.

id.description: Its own id, `kaynak-N`.

key.description:
The attribute that names a row the same whatever its place in the table (docs/adr/0533 §1): its value is unique
among the rows and not empty. A reload follows a label pin to the row of the same value when the table was
written again with other row ids, and says the pins whose row is gone. None: a row is its row id, the rule
of every bound layer before.

layer.description: The drawing's layer that is its working copy.

parked.description:
The label pins of objects that left the part (docs/adr/0578 §3): the object's row is in the table but outside
`extent` (it was moved out, or the part was narrowed), so the layer holds no object for its pins. They are kept
here with the row's lasting id and its key's value, not drawn, and go back to the object when the row comes
into the part again; a row gone from the table takes its parked pins with it.

relative.description:
The file's path from the project file's folder, `/` between its parts (docs/adr/0506): written on saving when
the file lies on the same disk, so a project moved with its data (or packed with Paketle) finds it again; read
only when `path` is not there and the file it names has the same content. A database has none.

revision.description: The SHA-256 (64 hex digits) of the file when the layer last matched it: what a write or a reload compares with.

srid.description: The EPSG code the table declares, none for an undefined system.

uniques.description:
The table's unique constraints and plain unique indexes as the link last read them (docs/adr/0755 §1): no two
records of the layer hold the same values in their columns.

writable.description: Whether the table can be written: a feature or attribute table of a file KentOS may write.

SourceOverrides.description: What Tabloyu güncelle does with a cell changed by hand since its file was last read (docs/adr/0327 §5).

oneOf.description: Kept while the file's cell there stays as it was.
The file's words written over it.

SpaceBreak.description: Why a space's boundary is not what its walls say.

oneOf.description: The walls no longer close round its seed.
The selected columns cover the complete wall-enclosed area.
A physical boundary source cannot be read safely.
An explicitly named wall/column was removed, changed kind or left its level.

SpaceBrief.description: The design brief for the spaces of one usage: what the designer aims at, never a legal limit.

adjacent.description: Usages one of its neighbours (a wall or an opening between) should have, each.

emsal.description:
How its rooms count for the floor area ratio (docs/adr/8030; `.kcad` schema 222). Absent: by their name and
use (`emsal_by_use`).

minPassage.description: The least net passage: the widest a body may be and still go between all the space's doors (a corridor's).

minWidth.description: The least net width: the largest circle inside the space, its diameter.

outdoor.description: An outdoor space of a unit (a balcony, a terrace): summed apart from its unit's rooms.

reach.description: Usages it should open into, each: by a door, a gap or a room separator.

usage.description: The usage it is for, as the spaces write it (`SpaceFields::usage`).

SpaceColumns.description: Persistent physical column deduction. Absence preserves legacy wall-only areas.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

columns.description: Physical columns to deduct, within the same semantic level (no level: all).

floorOffset.description:
Döşeme kot farkı (docs/adr/8040 §3, `.kcad` schema 233): its finished floor over its storey's elevation, metres;
a wet room 2 cm lower. Absent: the top of the floor slab under it, else its storey's floor.

height.description:
Its inside height typed, metres: from its finished floor to its ceiling (PAİY 4(1)(ıı)); an asma tavan comes
first. Absent: up to the slab over it, else its storey's top (docs/adr/8040 §3).

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

method.description: What its rings stand for. Absent: the walls' inner faces.

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

parts.description: Its boundary: one part or more, each an outer ring and its holes.

scope.description: Unassigned uses only sources without an architectural level; target level must also be absent.

seed.description: The point inside it its boundary is found round from the walls; absent: its boundary is drawn.

sources.description: Explicit wall/column UUIDs, sorted and unique; absent preserves the legacy source search.

suspendedCeiling.description:
Asma tavan (docs/adr/8040 §3, `.kcad` schema 233): its suspended ceiling's underside over its finished floor,
metres; its inside height. Absent: none.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

unit.description:
The group it belongs to (docs/adr/0773, `.kcad` schema 138): an independent unit, a common area or an outdoor
area of the building's program, by its id. Absent: none.

void.description:
A void (docs/adr/0708): a shaft, a lift shaft, an opening in the floor — no floor in it. Drawn crossed, its area
kept out of the spaces' total and summed apart (schema 116). Absent: a room.

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

SpaceFinishes.description:
A space's finishes: its floor's, walls' and ceiling's, and its base's (the skirting's, docs/adr/0733 §3); the room
list's others (docs/adr/8038; Planlı Alanlar İmar Yönetmeliği 57(29)): its window sills' and parapets', its stair's
treads' and risers', and its handrails' and railings'.

railing.description: Küpeşte ve korkuluk: its handrails and railings (`.kcad` schema 228).

sill.description: Denizlik ve parapet: its window sills' and parapets' (`.kcad` schema 228).

stair.description: Merdiven basamak ve rıht: its stair's treads and risers (`.kcad` schema 228).

SpaceMethod.description: What a space's rings stand for (docs/adr/0342 §1): the walls' inner faces, their centre lines or their outer faces.

SpacePart.description: A part of a space: its outer ring and its holes.

SpaceRing.description: A closed ring: its vertices and, when an edge is an arc, one bulge per edge (absent: every edge straight).

SpaceScope.description: Source scope, independent of a target level. Absence preserves legacy searches.

SplineEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

SplitPolicy.description: A field's value in the pieces of a split object (docs/adr/0419).

oneOf.description: Each piece keeps the value.
The pieces' values are emptied.
The pieces take the field's default (none: empty).

The value is shared by the pieces' areas (lines: lengths), the total kept to the field's last
digit: integers and decimals with fraction digits.

StackMode.description: When a label is cut into lines.

oneOf.description: Only when it does not fit on one line.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

bulges.description:
A curved (spiral) stair's walking line (docs/adr/0709, schema 117): two bulges, the first its arc's (the tangent
of a quarter of its turn, counter-clockwise positive), the second 0; only on a two-point line. Absent: straight.

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

cut.description: The riser its cut line stands at; absent: none.

heightFromLevel.description:
Its whole rise is its level's floor-to-floor height (docs/adr/0724 §1, schema 125): its riser height is that
height over its risers, written again whenever the level's height changes; needs its level.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

landing.description: A landing's length along the walking line at a turn; absent: the width.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

post.description: A curved stair's centre post, its diameter (docs/adr/0724 §3, schema 125); absent: none.

pts.description: Its walking line, up from its first point: two points straight, three an L, four a U.

railings.description: Its railings' sides; absent: none (docs/adr/0705 §2, schema 115).

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

tread.description: A tread's depth along the walking line.

winders.description:
A balanced stair (balansmanlı, docs/adr/8045 §1, schema 241): this many treads balanced either side of each turn
of its walking line instead of a landing there, every tread its tread on the walking line, those at the inner
side narrowing towards the corner (PAİY 31/2-c: at least 0.10 m there, 0.27 m in their middle); absent: a
landing at each turn.

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

at.description: When, as the caller wrote it (ISO 8601).

by.description: Who accepted it, when the caller says.

expected.description: What the standard asked for and what the drawing had when it was accepted.

kind.description: The finding's kind, as `cad.standards.check` names it (`layerColor`, `tableStyleDefinition` …).

layer.description: The drawing's layer it is about, by id, when it is one.

reason.description: Why it is kept (not empty, at most `MAX_STANDARD_EXCEPTION_REASON` characters).

revision.description: … and its revision (empty for a standard without one).

standard.description: The standard it was found against: the source's id (a package's `id`, else the standard's name) …

subject.description: What it is about: a layer's, a style's, a line type's or a block's name.

StatedLength.description:
A length stated for one edge of an area's ring (docs/adr/5020): the ring in the area's order (the outline, its holes,
then each further part's outline and holes; 0 first), the edge from the ring's vertex `edge` to the next, the length a
plain decimal in metres as written.

StationEquationDef.description:
A station equation (docs/adr/0901 §6): the km where it is (read before it), the km after it, and whether the km
grows after it.

name.description: The person in charge; "Atanmamış" for none.

StatusCount.description: How many dossiers are in each status (a dashboard's figures).

StatusOption.description: A status's name and the tone it is shown in (`neutral`, `info`, `warning`, `success`, `danger`).

StreetSource.description: The streets' layer and which of its attributes say what.

name.description: Yol adı.

oneOf.description: A point object's position: part 0 its own, `k` its `k`th extra point (docs/adr/0174).
A line's, arc's or elliptical arc's start; an opening's start jamb midpoint.
Its end; an opening's end jamb midpoint.
A circle's, arc's or ellipse's centre; an opening's jamb midpoints' midpoint.

A path's vertex: part 0 the object's own path, `k` its `k`th extra part; ring 0 the outer ring, `h` its
`h`th hole; the vertex's index in the ring. On an opening, part/ring 0 and index 0..3 name
start-left, start-right, end-left, end-right jamb corners (host direction); no symbol pieces.
The middle of a line (all zero) or of a path's edge from vertex `index` to the next.

A point along an edge or a curve (docs/adr/0263 §1): a line's (all zero) or a path's edge from vertex `index`
to the next, at the fraction `t` of its chord or of its arc's sweep; an arc's (`a0 + t·sweep`), a circle's
(`t·2π` from east) or an ellipse's (`t0 + t·sweep`) curve (all zero). `t` within 0 and 1.

SubRef.description: A place on an object by the object's persistent id: what a dimension's point follows.

broken.description:
Why it no longer follows its object ([`SUBREF_BROKEN`]); none while it does. The point keeps its last
coordinates.

path.description:
When `uid` is an insert, the piece inside it the place is on (docs/adr/0263 §3): each number the object's
place in that level's definition, every one but the last an insert; empty (not written) for the object itself.

SubnetworkReach.description: Which way a subnetwork reaches from its controller (docs/adr/0557 §2).

oneOf.description: Akış aşağı: the way the edges' directions lead.
Bağlı: along every connection, any way.

Subtype.description: One subtype: a code of the subtype field's list, its label, and what it narrows.

label.description: What it is called; empty: the subtype field's label of its code.

SubtypeField.description: What a subtype changes on one field; a field it does not name keeps the layer's rules.

default.description: The value a new record of this subtype starts with, in its field's canonical text.

required.description: A record of this subtype has a value (in addition to the field's own rule).

values.description: The codes of its value list this subtype offers (a field with a value list); none: all of them.

SuperCurveDef.description:
A curve's superelevation (docs/adr/0904 §2): its PI, the full rate (a grade, 0.07 is 7 %), the runoff length (level crown to full
rate), the share of the runoff before the curve (0–1) and the extra width on its inside.

SuperRowDef.description: A row of a superelevation schedule written by station: the alignment's own station and each side's slope.

SuperelevationDef.description:
A superelevation schedule (docs/adr/0904): on an alignment of its own PIs (its revision held), the normal cross
slopes of the left and the right side (grades, outward; falling outward negative; docs/adr/0977) and how it is had.

pivot.description: The line the traveled way turns about (docs/adr/0931 §1); absent: the centreline.

SuperelevationMethod.description: How a superelevation schedule is had (docs/adr/0904 §2).

oneOf.description: From the curves, rotating about the centreline.
The rows written.

SuperelevationPivot.description:
The axis of rotation of a superelevation (docs/adr/0931 §1): the centreline, an edge of the traveled way by side,
or the curve's inside or outside edge.

SurfaceCloudDef.description:
What a surface's points taken from point clouds are (docs/adr/0928 §2): the layer they were written to, the clouds,
classes, returns and area they were chosen by, the thinning, and what it cost: the ground points read and kept,
their coverage (0–1) and density (per m²) of the area, and the vertical error of the points left out against the
surface made then (absent when none was measured), and how many were outside it.

heights.description:
The clouds' heights as the call said them and the project's they were written in (docs/adr/1032; schema 196);
absent: the call said none, the points' heights are the files'.

vertical.description:
The clouds' vertical system as their files name it (docs/adr/1029; schema 195): a WKT's `VERT_CS`/`VERTCRS`
name or `EPSG:n` (a GeoTIFF key); absent: not known (a file naming none, sources naming different ones, or a
record made before the rule).

SurfaceEdit.description:
An edit of a terrain surface (docs/adr/1560), as Civil 3D's surface definition keeps them: Nokta ekle (a point at
a place no record has), Kot değiştir (every point record at the place takes the height), Kenar ekle (a TIN edge
between the corners at two places; Kenar çevir is the other diagonal of two triangles) and Üçgen sil (the kept
triangle at the place goes).

oneOf.description:
Yüzey yapıştır (docs/adr/3920; `.kcad` schema 214): another surface of the project, by its id, pasted in as Civil
3D's Paste Surface and OpenRoads' Merge do: where its kept triangles lie, this surface's records made so far go
and its corners and edges come in; the rest is triangulated anew round it.

SurfaceExclusion.description: A point record left out of a surface: its place (docs/adr/0916 §6).

SurfaceSources.description:
Where a surface's points or breaklines come from: every object of the layers (and of the groups' layers), and the
objects named by their persistent ids.

SurveyAdjustment.description:
A network adjustment the project accepted, `da-N` (docs/adr/1740): what it was made of (its baselines, its known
points, the one the free stage held), with what (the variance factor, the rule class and package checked), what
it said (both stages' m0, degrees of freedom and model test; whether the rules held) and in which frame and epoch.
The accepted points it made name it.

id.description: `da-N`.

sessions.description:
The baseline sessions `bo-N` whose full covariance it was adjusted with (docs/adr/4920); none: each baseline's
own 3×3 alone.

SurveyAntenna.description:
A session's antenna: its type and serial, the height measured and to where; a slant height with the maker's
radius and the measuring point's height above the ARP; the eccentricity east and north (m).

SurveyBaseline.description:
A baseline vector `bz-N` (docs/adr/1740): from mark to mark, ΔX, ΔY, ΔZ in Earth-centred, Earth-fixed axes (m)
with the antenna heights applied by its processor, and its covariance xx, xy, xz, yy, yz, zz (m²); its campaign,
when it was observed (GPS time), how and with what it was made, the file it was read from and its id there; left
out with a reason, never deleted; whether it goes into the network adjustment.

id.description: `bz-N`.

source.description: Its id in the file (GVX's `ID`, the text's line).

SurveyBaselineSession.description:
A baseline session `bo-N` (docs/adr/4920): baselines processed together from simultaneous observations of common
satellites, as GVX 1.0 keeps a `SESSION`: its id in the file, its time, its baselines and the cross-correlation
blocks between them. A block's nine numbers go row by row, the rows the `row` baseline's X, Y, Z and the columns the
`col` baseline's; a complete session of n baselines has n(n − 1)/2 blocks.

id.description: `bo-N`.

name.description: Its id in the file (GVX's `SESSION ID`).

epoch.description: The epoch its accepted points are given in (decimal year); none: the project's.

id.description: `kp-N`.

velocity.description: The velocity grid that moves its solutions to that epoch.

work.description: The map's work item it is (`is-N`, docs/adr/1200), by id alone.

SurveyFile.description: A file the archive rests on: an absolute path and the SHA-256 of the content read (its revision).

SurveyFileFormat.description: What a session's original file is.

oneOf.description: A processing report (a solution's).
NGS's GNSS Vector Exchange 1.0 (baseline vectors; docs/adr/1740).
KentOS's baseline text: `B;from;to;dX;dY;dZ;xx;xy;xz;yy;yz;zz` (docs/adr/1380 §5).

SurveyGrid.description: A grid by its name and SHA-256 (lower-case hex), as the device's grid library keeps it.

SurveyKnown.description:
A known point `bn-N` (docs/adr/1740): a mark's given coordinates (a TUSAGA-Aktif or TUTGA station, an older C1
point) in a geographic frame at an epoch, the network's datum: held fixed, or with standard deviations north,
east, up (m) weighted; its own velocity in the frame's Earth-centred X, Y, Z (m/yr, from its epoch; a station's
published velocity, docs/adr/2520); where they come from; left out with a reason, never deleted.

id.description: `bn-N`.

SurveyPoint.description: A point accepted into the project: its mark, its object, its result now and its older ones (oldest first).

id.description: `kn-N`.

SurveyReceiver.description: A session's receiver: its type, serial and firmware.

SurveyResult.description:
What an accepted point is, once made: its solutions and method, the mark's position in the solutions' frame and
epoch, the epoch decision it was moved to, each session's vertical antenna height, σ when known, the project's x,
y and z, whether the coordinate chain was complete, and why it was made again.

adjustment.description: The network adjustment `da-N` it was made by (method `network`; docs/adr/1740).

velocity.description: Its velocity, read from the velocity grid the user gave (docs/adr/4920), never made up.

SurveySession.description: A session: one occupation of one mark.

id.description: `os-N`.

observations.description: The positions an NMEA log or a GPX file gave, as the reader read them.

SurveySettings.description:
The project's survey constants and tolerances (docs/adr/0169 §3): the
refraction coefficient k of trigonometric heights, and the greatest
differences a field book's two faces are checked against; the mean
ellipsoidal height of the ground values and whether the survey windows
reduce lengths to the grid (docs/adr/0171); the a priori standard
deviations of a network adjustment (docs/adr/0203 §1). Angles are in
radians, lengths in metres. An absent tolerance is not checked; the
differences are still shown.

faceHz.description: The two faces' horizontal reading difference.

faceSlope.description: The two faces' slope distance difference.

groundHeight.description:
The project's mean ellipsoidal height (m), within [−500, 9000]: the
ground values of Mesafe ölç and Alan hesapla (docs/adr/0171 §2;
schema 16). Points' elevations are not used: whether orthometric or
ellipsoidal is not known.

sigmaCentering.description: Each end's centering, the instrument's and the target's, m (schema 28).

sigmaDirection.description:
A direction's a priori standard deviation, radians (docs/adr/0203 §1;
schema 28); absent: [`SIGMA_DEFAULTS`]'s.

sigmaPpm.description: A distance's part per million of its length (schema 28).

twoWay.description:
A traverse leg's horizontal distance measured from its two ends
(schema 15).

SurveySolution.description: A provider's solution of a session.

adjust.description: It goes into the adjustment (when not excluded).

antennaApplied.description: The vertical ARP height its maker took off (m); 0: the position is the antenna's.

covariance.description: The full covariance NN, NE, NU, EE, EU, UU (m²).

excluded.description: Why it is left out; present: excluded (it stays in the record).

from.description: A receiver solution's positions: the first and last place in the session's (both in) and the fixes taken.

hdop.description: The largest HDOP (no unit: geometry, not metres).

id.description: `cz-N`.

srid.description: The geographic system its coordinates are in (an EPSG code of the registry).

SurveyTolerance.description:
The limits a known point's place may lie from its mark's accepted point (docs/adr/4520), kept in the project with
where they come from (docs/adr/4920): a regulation's article, an administration's stricter specification
(BÖHHBÜY Madde 103(1)(c)).

SurveyUse.description: Objects made from accepted points (a surface, a contour): the operation, the objects and each point's revision.

id.description: `kb-N`.

TableAlign.description: A column's alignment; its cells sit in the middle of their rows.

TableBreaks.description:
A table drawn in parts (docs/adr/1030 §7): each part at most `height` metres deep (it takes rows while they fit,
at least one, the first the heading row and one more, never cutting a merged range), the next `gap` metres along
its rows from the one before, the heading row drawn again at the top of each unless `once`.

TableCellStyleDef.description: One of a table style's cell styles (AutoCAD's Title, Header or Data), every field optional.

align.description: Its words' horizontal alignment (group 170's left, centre or right).

borderWeight.description: Its borders' weight on the paper, mm, 0 the thinnest line (groups 274–279).

color.description: Its words' colour, `#rrggbb` (group 62).

height.description: Its words' height on the paper, mm (group 140).

horizontalMargin.description: The room between its words and its left and right borders, paper mm (group 40).

textStyle.description: The text style its words are written in, by its name (AutoCAD's group 7).

verticalMargin.description: The room between its words and its top and bottom borders, paper mm (group 41).

TableCheck.description: A CHECK constraint of a bound table (docs/adr/0755 §1).

columns.description: The table's columns it reads, in the table's order.

name.description: Its name; none for SQLite's constraint without one, which the database names by its text.

sql.description:
Its condition as the table gives it: the inside of PostgreSQL's `CHECK (…)` (`pg_get_constraintdef`), SQLite's
as its `CREATE TABLE` text writes it.

tableOnly.description:
Only the table judges it (docs/adr/0755 §3): it reads a column whose comparisons KentOS cannot follow (a
collation other than byte order, SQLite's affinity other than the field kind's, PostgreSQL's blank-padded
`character(n)`); written only as `true`.

aligns.description: Each column's alignment, as many as there are columns; absent: all left.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

breaks.description: Its parts (Tabloyu böl, docs/adr/1030 §7, `.kcad` schema 182); absent: one part.

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

cells.description:
The cells' words, row by row, a row as many as there are columns;
one line each, empty for an empty cell.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

columns.description: Its columns' widths, left to right, metres.

fields.description: Its cells bound to a source: their words are its value (docs/adr/0327 §3).

font.description: Its typeface; absent: the project's, in the look of docs/adr/0055.

formulas.description: Its formulas: their cells' words are their results (docs/adr/0327 §2).

frame.description:
Its frame's width, metres: the outline drawn as a band that wide
inside it (Kalın çerçeve); absent: a line as the others.

grid.description: Which of its lines are drawn; absent: all.

header.description: The first row is its heading: bold, centred.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

merges.description: Merged ranges: each range's words in its top left cell, its others empty.

oblique.description:
How far its letters lean, degrees, positive with their tops to the
right; within ±`MAX_OBLIQUE`, never 0 (upright is the field's absence).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

overrides.description: The fields set apart from its style by hand (docs/adr/0322 §5), by name (`TEXT_OVERRIDES`), as a dimension's.

rotation.description: Degrees counter-clockwise from east: its rows run along it.

rows.description: Its rows' heights, top to bottom, metres.

source.description: Where its rows came from (Tabloyu güncelle); absent: written by hand.

styles.description: Its cells' styles, a later over an earlier (docs/adr/0327 §1).

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

tableStyle.description:
The project's table style it follows, by its id (docs/adr/1126 §3, `.kcad` schema 185): what the table does
not set itself the style gives its drawing (`styled`); absent: none.

textStyle.description: The project's text style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

TableGrid.description: Which of a table's lines are drawn, when not all.

oneOf.description: Its outline alone.
Its outline and the lines between its rows.
None: the words alone.

TableSource.description: Where a table's rows came from (docs/adr/0184 §5).

oneOf.description: Koordinat çizelgesi: the points and vertices of these objects.
Alan çizelgesi: these areas, their area and perimeter.
Öznitelik tablosu: these objects' attributes.

A CSV or Excel file by its name (and sheet). Linked (docs/adr/0327 §5): its path (absolute, or from the
drawing's folder), the SHA-256 of the bytes last read, the cells they gave (the embedded copy: what a cell
changed by hand differs from), what is done with such a cell, and an optional unique row key;
unlinked, it is chosen again to update.

keyColumn.description: Zero-based column whose nonempty values identify rows across file revisions.

oneOf.description:
Blok çizelgesi (docs/adr/0327 §4): the inserts of the blocks named (none named: every block placed) counted,
by the attribute `by` when given; written again by the document at every step. `columns` (docs/adr/0721 §4,
Revizyon listesi): each row's further cells, an attribute's or a datum's name each, its row's distinct values
that are not empty in the drawing's order joined with “; ”; a schedule of one block with them leaves out its
Blok column, every row of which would read the same. At most [`MAX_SCHEDULE_DATA`].

Kapı ve pencere, mahal, kolon ya da duvar çizelgesi (docs/adr/0344 §3): the objects of `of` that the filter
takes, a row each (alike ones one row when grouped), in the columns' order, sorted, with a total; written again
by the document at every step, which writes `members` too: each data row's objects by their persistent ids.

byLevel.description:
Kat kat (docs/adr/8029; `.kcad` schema 221): a units schedule's row for each group on each storey it has
rooms on, storey by storey, its areas the storey's part (the metrekare cetveli's rows).

units.description:
A units schedule's (docs/adr/0795): each row's program groups by their ids, beside `members` (a unit without
spaces is still a data row); a heading's and a subtotal's none. Written by the document; absent elsewhere.

oneOf.description:
Veri çıkarımı (docs/adr/1030): a recipe's rows from the open drawing and other drawings read only, with what
they were written from (the sources' digests, the rows' keys, the cells last extracted); written again by
Tabloyu güncelle, never at every step (a drawing it reads is a file).

copy.description:
The extracted cells as last written (heading, data rows, total): a cell of them that the table reads otherwise
was changed by hand. Only the recipe's columns: the table's further columns are the user's.

keys.description:
Each data row's key as last extracted, in the rows' order: a grouped row's word cells, an ungrouped row's
occurrence path; unique.

overrides.description: What Tabloyu güncelle does with a cell changed by hand whose source changed too.

read.description: The other drawings and the joined file as last read.

oneOf.description:
Emsal ve TAKS tablosu (docs/adr/8030; `.kcad` schema 222): the parcel's zoning against the drawing as PAİY 57/3
asks the approved project to show it (the parcel, the emsal and TAKS with the areas they allow beside the
drawing's, the construction area) and each storey's area counted in and out; written again by the document at
every step and when the project's settings change.

Otopark hesabı (docs/adr/8036; `.kcad` schema 227): the independent units' parking need by Otopark Yönetmeliği
Ek-1 against the drawing's places; written again by the document as Emsal ve TAKS tablosu is.

Sığınak hesabı (docs/adr/8036; `.kcad` schema 227): the units' shelter people by Sığınak Yönetmeliği 8/a against
the drawing's shelter; written again by the document as Emsal ve TAKS tablosu is.

TableStyle.description: One rule of a layer's table (docs/adr/0413 §1).

color.description: The text's colour, `#RRGGBB`.

condition.description: When it holds: an expression over the record (`Kat > 3 ve Durum = 'kotu'`).

field.description: The field whose cell it paints, by name; absent: the whole row.

header.description: The heading row's cells: the first row after the title, when the table has a heading.

id.description: One of its kind among the project's table styles.

name.description: Its name: trimmed, one of its kind whatever its letters' case.

title.description: The title row's cells: the first row when it is one merged range across every column.

TableUnique.description: A unique constraint or a plain unique index of a bound table (docs/adr/0755 §1).

name.description: Its name; none for SQLite's constraint without one.

nullsEqual.description: Two empty (NULL) values count as the same (PostgreSQL's `NULLS NOT DISTINCT`); written only as `true`.

TagBreak.description: Why a tag's words are no longer its object's.

oneOf.description: Its object is gone.

anchor.description: The point of its object it ties to, which the document writes.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

content.description: Its template; absent: its object's kind's.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

leader.description: A line from its frame to the point it ties to.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

of.description: The object it tags, by its persistent id.

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

size.description: Its words' height on paper, millimetres; absent: 2.5.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

text.description: Its words: its template filled with its object's values, which the document writes.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

oneOf.description:
Round the first line only (docs/adr/8027): a room's number in its ellipse, its name and area below, as
Mimarlar Odası's room tag (KCAD schema 219).

TemplateBenchDef.description:
A slope's benches (docs/adr/0958): every `height` m up a cut slope or down a fill slope a bench `width` m wide, its
surface falling `fall` outward (a grade, 0.04 is 4 %; absent: level; docs/adr/0977). From the project's geotechnical report: KentOS gives none.

TemplateComponentDef.description:
A component of a template's side, outward from the axis: its width and cross slope (a grade: rise over run, −0.025
is −2.5 %; falling outward negative; docs/adr/0977).

TemplateDef.description: A template (docs/adr/0903 §3): its left side and its right; absent right: the left's mirror.

pavement.description: The pavement under the finish grade, both sides alike (docs/adr/0975 §2); absent: none (an older template).

TemplateDitchDef.description: A ditch in a cut: its fore slope (horizontal per one vertical), its depth under the hinge and its bottom's width.

TemplateSideDef.description:
A template's side: its components outward from the axis and its end condition: the cut and fill slopes (horizontal
per one vertical, 1.5 is 3/2) and an optional ditch in the cut.

bench.description: The cut slope's benches (berme, docs/adr/0958; KCAD schema 177).

fillBench.description: The fill slope's benches (docs/adr/0958; KCAD schema 177).

TenantKind.description: A tenant is an organisation or a person's personal space (docs/adr/0015).

oneOf.description: Opened by the server for one person; its only member is its owner, others come through sharing.

TerminalConfig.description:
A configuration of a device (docs/adr/0562 §2): the terminals and paths of the points whose `by` attribute holds
`value` (caseless).

TerminalDevice.description:
A device: every point of the junction layer `layer` has these terminals. An edge attached to one of its terminals
goes on through the device only to a terminal on a path with it; an edge that names none (or one the device does
not have) passes to every terminal and the trace is said to be unverified.

by.description:
The attribute of the device's points that names their configuration (docs/adr/0562 §2): a point whose value is
a configuration's has that configuration's terminals and paths; one with none, or an unknown value, has the
device's own (an unknown value is said). None: every point has the device's own.

configs.description: The configurations besides the device's own: 1–16 when `by` is named, none otherwise.

layer.description: A junction layer of the network (its id).

paths.description: 1–16 paths: each the ids of two or more terminals connected to one another through the device.

boundary.description: The outer boundary: a closed polyline's or an area's id; its vertices take the surface's heights.

breaklines.description: The breaklines: each line's and polyline's path, every vertex with an elevation.

built.description: The digest (64 lower-case hex digits) of the sources it was last made and accepted from; absent: never.

clouds.description: The ground points taken from point clouds into its point layers (docs/adr/0928 §2), each layer's record.

edits.description:
The edits made on it, in their order (docs/adr/1560; `.kcad` schema 196): a point added, a point's height set,
an edge put in between two corners, a triangle taken out. Made again with the surface from its sources: an
edit that no longer fits is said back, not dropped.

excluded.description:
The point records left out of it (docs/adr/0916 §6; a repair: a spike, a shot twice): each place, exactly as the
record's; the drawing's points stay as they are.

id.description: Its id, unique in the project; what a profile or a section names.

maxEdge.description: The edge method: an outer triangle whose outer edge is longer than this is left out, m; absent: none.

name.description: Its name (“Mevcut zemin”), unique in the project.

points.description: The points: each point object's places with an elevation.

tolerance.description: Two records at one place are one vertex when their heights are this close, m; absent: 0.001.

voids.description: The voids: closed polylines' or areas' ids.

TextAlign.description:
Which point of a text its `p` is (docs/adr/0145 §1): horizontally its
left, centre or right; vertically on its baseline, at its bottom (0.2 of
its height under the baseline), its middle (half its height over it) or
its top (its height over it). The left of the baseline, where a text
always stood, is no value but the field's absence: a text has one
spelling.

TextColumns.description:
A multi-line text's static columns (docs/adr/0324 §1): `count` columns of the box's width, `gap` heights
apart, each `height` metres tall; lines past the last column's height go on down in it.

gap.description: The space between two columns, heights.

TextEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

align.description: Where `p` is on the text; absent: the left of the baseline (docs/adr/0145).

annotative.description:
Its scales: drawn at the paper height it was given at every scale it takes part in, hidden
at others (docs/adr/0323); absent: one height.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

boxWidth.description:
Metres, finite and over 0: the lines wrap word by word to this width.
Absent: they end only at line breaks.

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

fields.description: Ranges of its letters bound to a source (docs/adr/0325 §1), in order, not overlapping; absent: none.

font.description: Its typeface; absent: the project's, in the look of docs/adr/0055.

labelOf.description:
The object whose label this text writes (Etiketleri yazıya çevir's
“Nesneye bağlı”, docs/adr/0175 §4): its persistent id. The text
follows the object as its label at `label_scale`; absent: a text of
its own. Given with `label_scale` or not at all.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

labelScale.description: The scale's denominator (1:N) the linked label is written at; finite, over 0.

layout.description:
Its indents, tab stops and columns (docs/adr/0324 §1); absent: none, a tab every
`DEFAULT_TAB` heights, one column.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineSpacing.description:
The distance between the lines' baselines in 5/3 of the height (DXF's
group 44); absent: 1. From `MIN_LINE_SPACING` to `MAX_LINE_SPACING`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

mask.description:
The text's box is filled with the drawing area's colour before the
text is drawn (Netcad's “fon”): what lies under it does not show.

oblique.description:
How far its letters lean, degrees, positive with their tops to the
right; within ±`MAX_OBLIQUE`, never 0 (upright is the field's absence).

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

overrides.description: The fields set apart from its style by hand (docs/adr/0322 §5), by name (`TEXT_OVERRIDES`), as a dimension's.

path.description:
The curve its letters stand on (Eğri boyunca yazı, docs/adr/0196 §1),
in its own frame; absent: a straight text.

runs.description:
The letters' formats: ranges of the text's Unicode scalar values (not
UTF-16 units), in order, not overlapping, each with a format; a run
with no format is not written, and touching runs of one format are one.
Absent: none.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

textStyle.description: The project's text style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

widthFactor.description:
The letters' width times this, the height kept (Netcad's “sıkışma”,
DXF's group 41); absent: 1. Finite, over 0, at most `MAX_WIDTH_FACTOR`.

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

TextField.description: A range of a text's letters bound to a source (docs/adr/0325 §1).

broken.description: Why its value cannot be read; its letters are then `####`. Absent: it reads.

format.description: How a number is written; absent: the project's decimals and unit.

start.description:
Its first letter and the one past its last, counting Unicode scalar values (as a run's); its letters are the
value last written.

TextLayoutEngine.description:
The explicitly selected, frozen text-layout profile (ADR 0914).
Absence preserves legacy layout; loading a file never upgrades it.

TextPath.description:
The curve a text's letters stand on (docs/adr/0196 §1). Its vertices are
in the text's own frame: `p` its start, x along the text's `rotation`, y
square to it on the left, metres. The first vertex is `p` itself and is
not written; `pts` are the ones after it. The frame carries the curve with
the text when it moves, turns or scales.

bulges.description:
Edge i's bulge, from vertex i to vertex i + 1 (vertex 0 is `p`):
DXF's tan(θ/4), counter-clockwise positive; as many as `pts`. Absent:
every edge straight.

pts.description: The vertices after `p`, at least one.

TextRun.description: A range of a text's letters and their format (docs/adr/0182 §1).

color.description: Its own colour, as an object's (`#E5484D`, or a theme name); absent: the text's.

script.description: Raised or lowered, at 0.6 of the height; absent: on the line.

start.description: Its first letter and the one past its last, counting Unicode scalar values.

TextScript.description: A run raised over the line (superscript) or lowered under it (subscript).

oneOf.description:
A stacked fraction (docs/adr/0324 §1): the run's letters before its first `/`, `#` or `^` raised over
those after it; `/` a horizontal bar, `#` a slanted one beside them, `^` none (a tolerance).

TextShift.description:
The value moved from its place (AutoCAD's text moved, DIMTMOVE 2): metres along the value's own direction and
across it (left positive).

bigFontFile.description:
The Big Font (SHX) a DXF STYLE named beside its font (group 4), written
back as it came (docs/adr/1120 §4; KCAD schema 184).

fontFile.description: The typeface file a DXF named for it, written back as it came.

height.description: The texts' height on paper, mm; absent: the tool's height.

id.description: One of its kind among the project's text styles (a UUIDv7).

name.description:
Its name: trimmed, one of its kind whatever its letters' case, never
`STANDARD_STYLE`.

TileGrid.description: A service's tile grid as read: its system and its matrices, coarsest first.

TileMatrix.description:
One matrix of a tile grid (docs/adr/0208 §3): its pixel's size in the
grid system's units, its top left corner as east and north (longitude
and latitude), whatever order the service wrote them in, its tiles' and
its own size in tiles.

TimeSystem.description: A time system a session's times are in (RINEX 3.05's codes, and UTC).

TmDefinition.description:
A transverse Mercator grid: its origin's latitude (0 when left out),
central meridian, scale and false origin.

customDatum.description: the project's own (exactly one of the two).

datum.description: The registry's datum by name; or

TokenIssued.description: The session a program got: its token (once), when it ends at the latest, and who signed in.

expiresAt.description: RFC 3339. Each use moves the idle limit; the session never outlives this.

token.description: `kentos_s_` and 64 hexadecimal digits; sent as `Authorization: Bearer …`.

TokenRequest.description: `POST /v1/auth/token`: a program signs in with a local account.

client.description: What the program is: `desktop`, `mobile`, `agent`, `python`, … (lower-case letters, digits and `-`).

label.description: The device or the program's name as its person knows it ("Ofis bilgisayarı").

TokenScope.description: What a personal access token may do.

oneOf.description: Reads only: `GET` and `HEAD`.
Reads and writes as its account may.
` ±upper`.
` +upper -lower`.
The largest and the smallest value instead of the number: `max/min`.

TopologyDecision.description: A review's decision on a finding (docs/adr/1260 §1).

oneOf.description: İstisna: left on purpose.
Hata: confirmed, to be put right.

TopologyException.description:
A finding marked as left on purpose: its rule, its objects' persistent
ids in the finding's order, and its place.

decision.description:
What the review decided (docs/adr/1260 §1): absent, an exception (left on purpose); `error`, a confirmed
error to be put right. Schema 189.

digest.description:
The objects' geometry when it was marked (docs/adr/0589 §3): 16 lowercase hexadecimal digits. The geometry
changed since, the exception lapses and its finding is open again; absent (marked before schema 99): kept while
the rule, the objects and the place are the same.

reason.description: Why, as the reviewer wrote it (not blank, at most [`TOPOLOGY_REASON_MAX`] characters). Schema 189.

ruleDigest.description:
The rule's version when it was marked ([`rule_digest`]): the rule changed since, the mark lapses. Absent (marked
before schema 189): kept whatever the rule. Schema 189.

scope.description:
What it covers: absent, the finding at its place; `objects`, every finding of the rule between these objects
in this order wherever it is. Schema 189.

TopologyProfile.description:
A quality profile (docs/adr/1260 §2): three lengths kept apart. The check's tolerance (`TopologySettings::tolerance`)
is the CAD nearness within which two places are one; `precision` is the step the coordinates are stored at (ArcGIS's
XY resolution: the tolerance is at least twice it); `acceptance` is the institution's threshold: no repair moves a
vertex of the source geometry farther than it. With a profile every exception and every error mark names its reason.

acceptance.description: Metres, finite, at least the precision.

edition.description: The profile's own edition as its owner writes it (“2026/1”), at most 50 characters.

name.description: The profile's name: the institution's or the job's (“Kadastro güncelleme”), 1–200 characters.

precision.description: Metres, within [`TOPOLOGY_PRECISIONS`]; the tolerance is at least twice it.

TopologyRule.description: A rule: its kind on a layer and, between layers, another layer.

id.description: One of its kind among the project's rules; exceptions name it.

layer.description:
The layer's id (a layer, not a group). A rule whose layer the project
no longer has stays and is not checked.

other.description: The other layer's id, for a rule between layers only.

value.description:
The value of a kind that takes one: a length in metres, an angle in
radians; absent: the kind's default.

oneOf.description: Çakışmamalı: the layer's areas do not overlap.
Boşluk olmamalı: no gap is closed in among the layer's areas.
İnce alan olmamalı: no part of an area is thinner than the value.
Yinelenmemeli: no edge of a line lies on another line, no point on another point.
Sarkan uç olmamalı: every line end meets the layer's line work.
Kısa kenar olmamalı: no edge is shorter than the value.
Küçük açı olmamalı: no corner is sharper than the value.
Geçerli olmalı: ADR 0201 §6's problems.
Ortak sınırda köşe eksik olmamalı: an area's vertex on a neighbour's edge is the neighbour's too.
… ile çakışmamalı: the layer's areas do not overlap the other's.
… içinde kalmalı: the layer's objects stay within the other's areas.
Sınırı … sınırlarında olmalı: the layer's areas' boundaries lie on the other's line work.
… çizgilerinin ucunda olmalı: the layer's points are at the other's line ends.
The finding at its place (within the tolerance).
Every finding of the rule between the same objects in the same order.

TopologySettings.description: The project's topology rules, tolerance and exceptions (docs/adr/0202 §1).

exceptions.description: Findings marked as left on purpose (docs/adr/0202 §3).

profile.description:
The institution's or the job's quality profile (docs/adr/1260 §2, `.kcad` schema 189): its name, the storage
precision of the coordinates and the acceptance threshold, apart from the check's tolerance above.

rules.description: The rules, in the order they are checked and listed.

TransferCreate.description: `POST /v1/tenants/{tenant}/dossiers`: a municipality's new transfer, as a draft.

TurnLayer.description:
A turn layer: its lines are turns; `field`'s number is a turn's delay (seconds), its empty value a forbidden turn;
without a field every turn of the layer is forbidden.

Ucs.description:
A user coordinate system: its origin in the world and the angle of its x
axis from the world's x (east), counter-clockwise, in radians, in
[0, 2π). Its y axis is square to x, counter-clockwise; it neither scales
nor mirrors. The world's is origin (0, 0), angle 0, kept as no setting.

angle.description: Its x axis from east, counter-clockwise.

monochrome.description: Drawn in the drawing's ink, its colours left aside.

plot.description: Drawn on a sheet (PDF, print); false: on the screen only.

oneOf.description: Bağımsız bölüm: a flat, a shop, an office; its own spaces summed for it alone.
Ortak alan: a shared corridor, stairs, a shaft; summed apart, never into a unit's total.
Dış alan: a garden, a car park; summed apart.

Eklenti (docs/adr/8031; `.kcad` schema 223; Kat Mülkiyeti Kanunu 2/a, 6): a place outside an independent unit,
allocated to it (a storage room, a garage, a coal room; `annexOf`); its gross counts into its unit's total gross
(PAİY 4/ğ-4), never into the common areas.

UploadBegin.description: `POST /v1/uploads`: what is about to be sent.

name.description: The file's name with its extension (`pafta-3.pdf`): its kind is read from it and checked against its bytes.

sha256.description: The whole file's SHA-256, 64 lower-case hexadecimal digits.

UploadView.description: An upload and how far it came.

expiresAt.description: When it is removed if nothing takes it.

mediaType.description: The media type of the name's kind; after the scan, the kind its bytes were found to be.

partMax.description: The largest part one request may carry, bytes.

received.description: Every byte arrived, matched the hash and passed the scan: a destination may take it.

receivedBytes.description: The bytes that arrived: the next part starts here.

oneOf.description: ISO text (YYYY-AA-GG).

VariableValue.description: A variable's value: none yet, true/false, a number or text.

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

ViewCategory.description: What kind of objects a view leaves out (docs/adr/0774 §1): its own category hide, the model untouched.

oneOf.description: Dimensions and dimension sets' members.
Tags.
Texts, paragraphs and leaders.
Hatches.
Block inserts: furniture, fixtures, symbols.
Spaces (their outline and label).
Grids and their bubbles.
View marks (section, elevation, detail).

ViewMarkBreak.description: Why a mark's words are no longer its target's.

oneOf.description: Its named view or sheet frame is gone.

angle.description: An elevation's looking direction, degrees from east, counter-clockwise; absent: 90 (north).

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

flip.description: A section looks to the right of its cut line's direction (absent: the left).

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

mark.description: The mark's number; empty: a sheet frame's order on its sheet.

order.description:
Its place in its layer's drawing order: lower first, equals in the
document's order; absent: 0; a 32-bit integer. Only a drawing's object has it.

points.description: A section's cut line (2 or more points); an elevation's bubble, a detail's circle's middle (one point).

size.description: Its words' height on paper, millimetres; absent: 2.5.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

transparency.description: How transparent it is, 0 to 0.9; absent: its source's (none for a layer).

wipeout.description:
An area's mask (AutoCAD's WIPEOUT, docs/adr/0264 §3, 0310): it fills with the drawing's background and covers
what is drawn before it; only an area has it.

words.description: The bubble's words, which the document writes.

oneOf.description: Kesit: a cut line with a bubble at each end, looking to one side.
Görünüş: a bubble looking one way.
Detay: a circle around the detail and a bubble on a leader.

ViewMarkLabel.description: The bubble's words, which the document writes from the target.

bottom.description: The bottom half: the target's number.

top.description: The top half: the mark's number.

ViewRecipe.description:
A named view's architectural recipe (docs/adr/0774 §1; Revit's view properties, Archicad's view settings): what a
sheet's map linked to the view draws. It is the view's, not the model's (no object changes) nor the person's (the
screen's level view, theme and layer panel stay theirs). `version` counts its changes: written by `cad.views.edit`.

combo.description: The combination of design options it shows by its id (docs/adr/0808): its choices, under the recipe's own.

crop.description: The map draws only the view's area, its frame's paper outside it empty (docs/adr/0781 §2; Revit's Crop Region).

detail.description:
The walls' detail the map draws (docs/adr/0781 §1; Revit's Detail Level, Archicad's Partial Structure Display);
none: its scale's, or the project's when it fixes one.

hidden.description: The categories left out, in their order.

layerState.description: A layer state of the project by its name, in this view only (docs/adr/0314 §1); none: the map's layers.

level.description: The level the map draws; none: the map's own.

mono.description: Every line black, hatches grey (docs/adr/0783 §1); a pen's colour still wins.

options.description: The design options it shows (docs/adr/0788 §3), a set's choice each; a set not named shows its primary.

pens.description:
The pens the map draws its categories with (docs/adr/0783 §1; Archicad's pen sets, Revit's object styles in a
view), each category once, in their order.

phase.description: The phases it shows (docs/adr/0346 §2); none: the project's phase view.

scale.description: The scale's denominator a linked map draws at (1:N), the view's middle kept; none: the view's box fitted.

template.description:
The view template it follows by its id (docs/adr/0783 §2; Revit's assigned View Template): the template gives
everything but the level and the crop, which stay the view's. An input may name it.

version.description: 1 for a new recipe, one more at each change; given in an input, it is ignored.

ViewTarget.description: What a mark points at: a named view (`view`, its id), or a map frame on a sheet (`sheet` and `item`, their ids).

ViewTemplate.description: A view template of the project (docs/adr/0783 §2): a recipe kept under a name, which views follow.

id.description: `t-` and its first name's FNV-1a; kept when renamed.

name.description: Trimmed, 1–64 characters, no control characters; unique.

recipe.description: What it draws: no level, crop or template.

VisibilityState.description: One of a visibility parameter's states: its name and the objects (local ids) it hides.

VolumeApprovalDef.description:
An approved earthwork volume's figures (docs/adr/0906 §5): when and by which revision of its definition, a note,
the totals and each stretch's cut and fill (from, to, cut, fill; the stretches with volume) as they were.

algorithm.description:
The method's algorithm by name and version they were computed by (docs/adr/1040, 1041; schema 197): none on an
approval made before.

at.description: The day it was approved, YYYY-MM-DD.

ended.description: How it ended, in the volume's history (docs/adr/0950; schema 173): none while it stands.

number.description:
Its number among the volume's approvals, from 1 (docs/adr/0950; schema 173); 0: approved before approvals were
numbered.

sources.description:
What the figures were computed from when approved, each as it was then (docs/adr/1041; schema 197): none on an
approval made before.

VolumeApprovalEnd.description:
How an approval ended (docs/adr/0950): the day (YYYY-MM-DD; none where it was not given), whether it was revoked
(else a later approval took its place) and why.

VolumeBenchDef.description:
The fill's foundation benched (diş kazısı, docs/adr/0906 §6): where the ground falls across steeper than `slope`
(a grade, 0.2 is 20 %; docs/adr/0977) under a fill, steps `height` (m) high; both the project's (its regulation, its soil report).

VolumeDef.description: An earthwork volume (docs/adr/0906, Netpro's kübaj hesabı): a corridor's, by a method, with the factors by stations.

approved.description: Its figures as approved; an approved volume's definition does not change.

bench.description: The fill's foundation benched (a section method's).

cell.description: The grid method's cell (m, docs/adr/0974; schema 179): 0.01 to 1000; the grid method only.

curve.description:
The volume on a curve by the sections' moments (docs/adr/0934; schema 169): each section's effective area
`A + κ·Q`; the average end area method only.

history.description:
Its approvals that ended, oldest first, each as it was approved with how it ended (docs/adr/0950; schema 173):
never changed nor removed.

rule.description:
Which two lines it measures between (docs/adr/0975 §2, Netpro's names); absent: the road's top against the
ground, stripped when it strips (as before the rule).

strip.description: The topsoil stripped by stations (a section method's).

VolumeDensities.description: A soil's densities (t/m³): in place (bank, yerinde), loosened (loose, gevşek) and compacted in the fill (sıkışık).

VolumeFactorDef.description:
The factors over a stretch of stations (docs/adr/0906 §4): the cut's (bank to the volume it makes, kabarma) and the
fill's (compacted to the volume it needs, sıkışma), each a multiplier; absent: not converted.

densities.description:
The soil's densities from the soil report (docs/adr/0957; KCAD schema 176): the factors follow from them, the
cut's bank over loose, the fill's compacted over loose (both volumes in loose m³, as a truck carries them); a
row with densities writes no factor of its own.

source.description: Where its factors or densities come from (the soil report, its borehole or test), in words (docs/adr/0957).

VolumeMethod.description: How an earthwork volume is computed (docs/adr/0906 §2–§3).

oneOf.description: The average end area between consecutive sections.
The prismoidal formula with a section in the middle of each pair.
Between the corridor's top surface and the terrain, the triangulations laid over each other.

Between the corridor's top surface and the terrain on a regular grid (docs/adr/0974; schema 179): at each cell's
centre the two heights' difference times the cell's area (the midpoint rule), the cell (`cell`, m) given by
the volume; KentOS gives none.

VolumeRule.description:
An earthwork volume's rule (docs/adr/0975 §2): the road's top (Yol) or the formation (Formasyon) against the ground
(Zemin) or the ground with its topsoil stripped (Bitkisel Toprak). The topsoil stripped is its own item (Sıyırma
Kazısı) whichever rule.

oneOf.description: Yol–Zemin.
Formasyon–Zemin.
Yol–Bitkisel Toprak.
Formasyon–Bitkisel Toprak.

VolumeSources.description:
What an earthwork volume is computed from, each as it is now (docs/adr/1040; ROAD-VOL-01): its corridor, the
corridor's alignment and profile, its regions' templates in order and once each, its superelevation schedule and
its terrain surface (the original ground; the design is the corridor's).

VolumeStripDef.description: The topsoil stripped over a stretch of stations (docs/adr/0906 §6): its depth (m) under the earthwork's footprint.

WallCaps.description: Whether an open wall's ends are closed by a line across it.

WallComponent.description: One layer of a wall's body, from its left face towards its right (`CAD-ARCH-04`): plaster, brick, insulation.

detail.description: The least detail it is drawn at as its own (its lines and hatch); below, it is part of the body.

edge.description: The lines along its sides; absent: the wall's.

materialId.description:
The project material it binds to (docs/adr/0785, `settings.arch.materials`), by its id: its `material`, `hatch`
and `edge` are the material's and follow it. Absent: its own text material, as before.

priority.description:
Its strength where walls meet (docs/adr/0340 §1), 1 to 9, the smaller the stronger: a joining wall's component
passes the host's weaker ones and stops at the first as strong. Absent: 3 (between a core's 1 and a finish's 5).

thickness.description: Its thickness, metres; absent: what the wall's width leaves of the others (one component at most).

wrap.description:
Uçta döner (docs/adr/0771 §3): at the wall's free ends and at a door's or a window's jambs this layer turns
across the end (a plaster's or an insulation's return, the end cap and the reveal one meaning), when it is one of
the face's outermost turning layers; the layers inside stop short by its thickness. Absent: it stops square.

WallDetail.description:
How much of a wall is drawn (`CAD-ARCH-12`), the least first: `Schematic` its outline and its style's fill,
`Standard` the components shown at construction scales, `Detailed` every component.

WallEntity.description:
A wall (`CAD-ARCH-01`, `02`): its path, the base line it was drawn along, with arcs as a polyline's bulges (one per
vertex, as the document keeps a polyline's: an open wall's last is 0); its width; where its body lies across the
justification line (the path moved `offset` to its left); the components it is built of, from its left face; its
ends; its height above its level; its architectural information. Its faces, ends, component lines and hatches are
drawn from these (`geom::wall` of the shared core), at the detail the drawing's scale asks.

attachments.description:
The photos and documents it carries, in their order (docs/adr/0225
§1); none on a block's objects.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

byLayer.description:
On a block's object, the parts without a value of their own that
follow the object's layer instead of the insert; in order, once each,
never one with a value of its own.

cleanup.description:
Its components are cleaned up by their priorities where another wall tees into or crosses it; false: the
walls meet at their faces only.

closed.description: Its path's last vertex joins its first: a ring of wall.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

components.description: Its body's layers from its left face; none: one plain body.

fill.description: The body's solid fill when drawn schematically (`#RRGGBB`); absent: none.

height.description: Its height above its level's floor, metres; absent: the level's height.

joins.description: How its ends join (docs/adr/0340 §1); absent: both by the rule.

labelPins.description:
Its labels moved, turned, pinned or hidden by hand (docs/adr/0212
§3.7), one a class at most.

linePattern.description:
Its own project line type by its name (docs/adr/0313 §1), its nearest built-in in `line_type`; absent:
`line_type`.

lineType.description: Its own line type; absent: its source's (the layer's, or the insert's in a block).

lineTypeScale.description: Its pattern's own factor, above 0, at most 1000; absent: 1. Always the object's own.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
